item.summary: In this paper, we study the spectral compressed sensing problem of recovering a spectrally sparse signal from linear compressive measurements. Exploiting the low-rank Hankel structure associated with the signal, we formulate a nonconvex fixed-rank optimization problem with a Hankel regularization. We propose a Superfast Iterative Hard Thresholding (SIHT) algorithm, where each iteration consists of a tangent-space least-squares update followed by a fixed-rank hard thresholding projection. SIHT is the first nonconvex algorithm with provable quadratic convergence for spectral compressed sensing. For random Gaussian measurements, it achieves exact recovery in the noiseless case and stable recovery in the noisy case with near-optimal sample complexity. To efficiently implement SIHT, we develop a parameterized conjugate gradient method for solving the least-squares subproblem, endowing SIHT with state-of-the-art computational and memory efficiency. Numerical experiments are provided to validate our results.
item.title: Superfast Spectral Compressed Sensing with Quadratic Convergence

item.summary: We propose a novel low-complexity soft-aided hard-decision decoding scheme for product-like codes, termed iterative bounded-distance decoding (iBDD) with graded scaled reliability and bit-flipping (GSRF). This scheme operates on four-level quantized soft information. It incorporates a graded scaled reliability rule to assign decoding confidence to the bounded-distance decoding result, and employs a bit-flipping rule based on bit-level and component-code-level reliability. A selective re-decoding rule is designed to further facilitate the error performance while keeping the number of BDD attempts in reasonably low levels. The decoding parameter design of iBDD-GSRF is investigated for product codes and staircase codes, respectively. Simulation results on both codes verify that iBDD-GSRF achieves a gain of more than 0.4 dB over the conventional iBDD, comparable to several existing unquantized soft-aided decoders.
item.title: Four-Level Quantized Soft Information Aided Hard-Decision Decoder for Product-like Codes

item.summary: Movable antennas (MAs) have recently emerged as a promising technology to enhance the wireless sensing performance by exploiting additional spatial degrees of freedom. In this work, we consider an MA-enabled near-field target localization problem under a device-based sensing architecture, where the sensing target actively transmits signals and the sensing receiver estimates its location based on the received signals. We adopt the squared position error bound (SPEB) as the sensing performance metric and aim to minimize the target's SPEB by optimizing the antenna placement at the sensing receiver. The resulting optimization problem is highly non-convex due to the minimum antenna spacing constraints and the intricate dependence of the SPEB on the antenna locations and the intractable form of SPEB. To tackle this problem, we first relax the inter-spacing constraints and accordingly formulate an antenna position distribution problem in terms of degree-4 truncated moments. The reformulated moment-based problem admits an equivalent semidefinite programming formulation and can be optimally solved using standard convex optimization solvers. Using truncated moment theory, we then recover an optimal antenna position distribution supported on a finite number of locations and construct an efficient clustered placement policy. Numerical results demonstrate that the constructed optimal distribution exhibits a three-cluster structure with source-dependent weights. The proposed antenna placement method outperforms conventional array geometries and closely approaches the exhaustive-search benchmark scheme.
item.title: Antenna Placement for Movable Antenna-Enabled Near-Field Target Localization

item.summary: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) provides a promising foundation for low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) monitoring. However, most existing studies focus primarily on position and bulk velocity, thus providing limited information about UAV rotor dynamics and orientation. To address this limitation, this paper develops an orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM)-ISAC framework that exploits UAV micro-Doppler signatures to estimate operational states, including rotor rate and rotor-axis orientation, thereby providing richer UAV state information beyond conventional ISAC localization and velocity sensing. The framework progresses from single-station micro-Doppler sensing to multi-station rotor-axis estimation. At each base station, micro-Doppler signatures are first extracted and used to estimate the rotor rate. The framework is then extended to a distributed ISAC network, where view-dependent micro-Doppler signatures from multiple sensing directions are fused to estimate the common rotor-axis direction. Since the fusion relies on Doppler-bandwidth features rather than complex channel phases, inter-station carrier-phase synchronization is not required. We show that three geometrically diverse views can locally identify both the rotor-axis direction and the unknown rotor-tip-speed scale. In addition, a feature-aware radar equation bridges blade radar cross section (RCS), sensing range, transmit power, and observation duration to micro-Doppler detection and rotor-rate estimation accuracy. The effects of residual motion and range migration on the coherent processing interval (CPI) are also analyzed. Simulations and experimental measurements validate the proposed framework and demonstrate the feasibility of rotor-rate estimation and multi-station rotor-axis sensing.
item.title: Micro-Doppler Sensing for UAV Flight-State Estimation in ISAC Networks

item.summary: We address an open problem raised by Polyanskiy and Wu in their textbook concerning the subadditivity of mutual \(f\)-information. We study two notions of generalized mutual information: mutual \(f\)-information, defined by \(\widetilde{I}_f(X;Y)=D_f(p_{XY}\|p_Xp_Y)\), and variational \((G,f)\)-information, obtained by minimizing an average of transformed \(f\)-divergences. For the first notion, we derive a sufficient condition on \(g(x)=x^2f''(x)\) that guarantees subadditivity under conditionally independent observations. This condition yields explicit families beyond the previously known examples generated by \(x\log x\) and \((x-1)\log x\). Our proof relies on the concavity of a generalized variance functional. For the variational notion, we extend existing sufficient conditions beyond the transforms \(G(x)\in\{x,\log(1+x),-\log(1-x)\}\). Using a comparison inequality for \(G^{-1}(G(A)+G(B))\), we obtain differential criteria for concave and convex transforms. Explicit constructions illustrate the resulting classes of subadditive information measures.
item.title: On the Subadditivity of Mutual f-Information

item.summary: Fluid antenna receivers can select a service position from partial port observations, but finite historical data leave uncertainty in the covariance used for that decision. We develop deployment-before-use reliability certification for a frozen partial-observation rule. A proper predictive density defines a history-based parameter region. Gaussian covariance envelopes, shared conditional-probability bounds and selector enclosures provide simultaneous risk bounds over continuous parameters and discontinuous port decisions. Separate history-coverage and integration budgets limit erroneous positive certification to 0.05 for a single qualification procedure under the stated stationary model and numerical assumptions. Confidence-set inclusion allows a new independent history to reuse the risk computation with the rule unchanged. In a structured Gaussian example with 32 candidate positions, five noisy probes and target outage 0.001, all 282 risk groups are qualified; the largest upper bound is 0.000999748. A separate coupled comparison gives a current-rule outage interval of $[7.6820,9.1266]\times10^{-4}$ and resolves lower outage than two observed-port controls using the same historical fit. One independently recalibrated history reuses the certificate without additional risk sampling. Unresolved and adverse-member controls delimit this reuse.
item.title: Finite-History Outage Certification for Partially Observed Fluid Antenna Receivers

item.summary: We propose a novel soft-aided hard-decision decoding scheme for product codes based on two-bit quantized reliability markers. In particular, one bit is used for a two-level tolerance miscorrection check to validate the bounded distance decoding (BDD) result, while the other identifies bits to be randomly flipped upon BDD failure and miscorrection. List decoding is incorporated to further facilitate the error performance. Density evolution is performed for the design of the quantization thresholds. Compared to iterative BDD, the proposed scheme requires only moderate increases in memory and computational overhead. Simulation results verify that our scheme outperforms several unquantized soft-aided decoders, while maintaining small memory costs and low BDD attempts.
item.title: Iterative Bounded Distance Decoding With 2-Bit Reliability Marker For Product-Like Codes

item.summary: Cooperative multi-agent semantic communication requires deciding not only how a transmitter encodes its observation, but also which resulting semantic content should be delivered to each receiver under a limited link budget. We introduce an encoder-agnostic transmitter-side framework for receiver-specific valuation of independently selectable semantic units, termed semantic atoms. Each atom is assigned a signed value that quantifies whether delivering it is expected to improve or degrade the intended receiver's downstream decision. We formulate this effect through a controlled-delivery utility and identify it via prospective randomized payload delivery before the receiver acts. A shadow receiver estimates this utility using only transmitter-available information, from which receiver-specific leave-one-out (LOO) and Shapley atom values are computed. Experiments on a four-receiver intersection benchmark show 68.4% accuracy in recovering the sign of non-negligible LOO atom effects and a Spearman correlation of 0.302 between estimated and reference LOO values. Under limited budgets, we show that receiver-specific selection consistently outperforms shared and random alternatives, demonstrating the benefit of adapting semantic ranking to the intended receiver. At full affordability, exhaustive subset selection also outperforms full-payload transmission, showing that transmitting all available content need not maximize receiver utility. Overall, our results show that receiver-specific semantic valuation can support effective budget-constrained communication despite imperfect atom-value estimation.
item.title: Receiver-Specific Interventional Valuation of Semantic Atoms for Budget-Constrained Multi-Agent Communication

AI.conclusion: PI码与aRS码在折叠Hamming度量下具有丰富的对偶、QMDS与重量分布结构，非共轭赋值点aRS码可渐近达到PI码长度，相关性质可推广至任意多项式模。
AI.method: 利用多项式理想、不可约多项式、非共轭赋值点、广义PI码、任意多项式模等代数工具进行编码理论分析。
AI.motivation: 探索折叠Hamming度量（等价于更大字母表上的Hamming度量）中PI码与aRS码的代数与度量结构，刻画其长度、对偶性、QMDS性质及重量分布。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文研究代数编码理论中的PI码与加法RS码，与无线通信、CSI获取/反馈/压缩及物理层AI无任何关联。
AI.result: 确定了PI码最大长度；证明PI码对偶为广义PI码，导出其双重QMDS性质与显式重量分布；证明不可约多项式定义的PI码对应非共轭赋值点的aRS码；这些aRS码渐近达到与PI码相同的长度；计算了其置换群；并扩展到任意多项式模。
AI.tldr: 研究折叠Hamming度量下多项式理想码与加法Reed-Solomon码的结构性质，包括最大长度、对偶码、QMDS性质、重量分布与置换群。

item.summary: We study structural properties of polynomial ideal (PI) codes and additive Reed--Solomon (aRS) codes in the folded Hamming metric (equivalently, the Hamming metric over a larger alphabet). We first determine the maximum possible length of PI codes, prove that the dual of every PI code is a generalized PI code, and deduce that PI codes are dually QMDS together with an explicit formula for their weight distribution. We then show that PI codes defined by irreducible polynomials correspond to aRS codes with pairwise nonconjugate evaluation points. For these aRS codes, the previous results on PI codes apply (duality, QMDS property and weight distribution). We show that, asymptotically, aRS codes with nonconjugate evaluation points achieve the same length as PI codes. We also compute the permutation group of such aRS codes. We also extend the family of PI codes to consider arbitrary polynomial modules (not necessarily pairwise coprime), and study when these and general aRS codes satisfy the QMDS and dually QMDS properties.
item.title: On the structure of polynomial ideal codes and additive Reed--Solomon codes

AI.conclusion: 近场波前工程与中空聚焦波束设计可有效增强空间功率区分，是提升近场物理层安全的可行手段。
AI.method: 使用均匀线阵/面阵（ULA/UPA）生成聚焦、弯曲、突变自聚焦与余弦波束；引入基于功率的指标量化合法用户与窃听者接收功率；对各类波束沿UPA垂直方向引入聚焦以独立控制两个维度的相位分布；提出中空聚焦波束，在发射孔径中设置非激活条带以形成受保护低功率区域。
AI.motivation: 无线传输易被窃听，波束成形可借助空间传播特性提升物理层安全；当系统进入大孔径阵列的辐射近场时，波前曲率带来新的空间波前工程机会，但不同波束类型在近场PLS中的性能尚缺乏系统比较。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文聚焦近场波束成形与物理层安全，属于无线物理层方向，但未涉及CSI获取、信道估计、CSI反馈压缩或AI方法，与研究者核心方向连接较弱。
AI.result: 垂直聚焦显著提升PLS性能；中空聚焦波束在视距（LoS）与用户附近（VoU）场景下均取得更优的PLS性能。
AI.tldr: 该文研究近场大孔径阵列下的物理层安全（PLS）波束设计，比较聚焦、弯曲、突变自聚焦和余弦等波束类型，并提出垂直聚焦与中空聚焦波束以增强合法用户与窃听者间的功率区分。

item.summary: With wireless transmission exposing information to potential interception by unintended receivers, physical layer security (PLS) offers a promising approach to securing wireless communications. Beamforming can mitigate this vulnerability by exploiting the spatial characteristics of wireless propagation to concentrate power toward the intended receiver while suppressing it at potential eavesdroppers. However, as wireless systems enter the radiating near field of large-aperture antenna arrays, the resulting wavefront curvature provides additional opportunities for spatial wavefront engineering to enhance PLS. In this work, we investigate the use of different beam types for PLS, including focused, curved, abruptly autofocusing, and cosine beams, generated using uniform linear and planar arrays (ULAs/UPAs). To quantify their performance, we introduce power-based metrics that characterize the power received by the legitimate user and a potential eavesdropper. For all beam types we introduce focusing along the vertical UPA direction, to independently control the phase distributions along the two UPA dimensions and enhance the power discrimination between the legitimate receiver and the eavesdropper. We also propose hollow-focused beams, in which an inactive strip is introduced in the transmitting aperture to create a protected low-power region between the transmitter and the legitimate receiver. The results demonstrate that vertical focusing dramatically enhances the PLS performance and that hollow-focused beams achieve superior PLS performance in both line-of-sight (LoS) and vicinity-of-user (VoU) scenarios.
item.title: Wavefront Engineering for Physical Layer Security in Near-Field Wireless Communications

AI.conclusion: 该工作为峰值功率约束下多址信道空中计算提供了编码器结构刻画与鲁棒性最优设计的理论框架，将无限维设计问题约化为有限维度并给出闭式解与高信噪比性能极限；其结论主要面向函数计算与信息论层面的最优性，未涉及CSI获取或信道估计等具体无线物理层应用。
AI.method: 针对单次使用复多址信道、逐点峰值功率约束的连续编码器集合，在发射机数量不少于四个时给出精确无噪恢复强制所有编码器具有保持两个和的公共仿射结构的条件；引入鲁棒性评分刻画无噪接收聚合量相对目标函数值变化的分离度；在该编码器族内将鲁棒性最大化建模为精确凸半无限规划（无松弛间隙地消除秩约束），构造达到最小均匀噪声放大常数的解码器；对包括经验方差在内的若干函数类推导闭式鲁棒最优编码器与评分；在温和正则条件下建立高信噪比下高斯均方误差的紧致极限，并分析利用输入分布降低平均误差与牺牲均匀鲁棒性的权衡。
AI.motivation: 空中计算需要在峰值功率约束下设计编码器以计算由分次求和构成的函数（如经验方差），但连续编码器的设计空间是无限维的，且在信道噪声下缺乏对鲁棒性的量化与最优设计理论。作者希望揭示编码器结构的内在约束，并将无穷维设计问题约化、给出噪声鲁棒性的最优解与理论极限。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦峰值功率约束下多址信道空中计算的编码器结构与鲁棒性理论，虽涉及无线信道与峰值功率约束，但与CSI获取、信道估计、CSI反馈/压缩及信道知识建模等研究方向无直接关联。
AI.result: 证明了≥4个发射机时精确无噪恢复强制编码器集的公共仿射结构，将无限维设计约化为有限系数选择；给出鲁棒性最大化的凸半无限规划形式及达到最小均匀噪声放大常数的解码器；对经验方差等函数类得到闭式鲁棒最优编码器与评分；给出高信噪比下高斯MSE的紧致极限，并量化了利用输入分布带来的平均误差降低与均匀鲁棒性损失之间的权衡。
AI.tldr: 该论文研究在单次复多址信道使用、峰值功率约束下，通过两个分别后处理的局部变换观测之和来计算经验方差等函数的空中计算（AirComp）问题，刻画了精确无噪恢复强制编码器具有共同仿射结构的条件，并提出鲁棒性评分与凸半无限规划来最优设计编码器。

item.summary: We study over-the-air computation of functions, such as empirical variance, formed by combining two separately postprocessed sums of locally transformed observations. We consider continuous encoders subject to pointwise peak-power constraints over a single use of a complex multiple-access channel. With four or more transmitters, we identify conditions under which exact noiseless recovery forces every continuous encoder collection into a common affine structure that preserves both sums, reducing infinite-dimensional encoder design to selecting a finite set of coefficients. To quantify resilience against channel noise, we introduce a robustness score that measures the separation of noiseless received aggregates relative to variations in the desired function value. Within this characterized encoder family, we formulate robustness maximization as an exact convex semi-infinite program, eliminating rank constraints without a relaxation gap, and construct a decoder that attains the minimum uniform noise-amplification constant. For several function classes, including empirical variance, we derive closed-form robustness-optimal encoders and scores. Under mild regularity conditions, we also establish sharp limits on the Gaussian mean squared error at high signal-to-noise ratios and show how using the input distribution reduces average error at the expense of uniform robustness.
item.title: It Takes Two Moments: Rigidity and Limits of Continuous Encoders for Over-the-Air Computation

AI.conclusion: 泄漏的模式能量可作为结构化可收集资源加以利用，二维模态-时间联合处理在存在信道估计与定时缺陷时仍具鲁棒性与实用价值。
AI.method: 基于倾斜OAM波束的Bessel阶差耦合律，建立高斯模式扩散模型与模式相干性度量；为每个活跃OAM模式分配不同的时域正交扩频码，并在OAM模式与可分辨多径时延构成的二维接收网格上联合合并解扩输出（二维模式-时间Rake）；同时提出有效分集度量以区分有限SNR下的合并增益与渐近分集阶数。
AI.motivation: OAM波束提供空间复用维度，但多径散射会展宽模式谱、造成模式间干扰（IMI），传统OAM解复用直接丢弃这些泄漏能量，造成性能损失。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文属于OAM/MIMO物理层分集与接收机设计，涉及多径、模式耦合与信道估计缺陷，但核心是扩频与Rake合并而非AI驱动的CSI获取、压缩或重建，AI成分缺失。
AI.result: 在28 GHz、四模式八阵元UCA、四径可分辨条件下，所提2D模态-时间Rake将BER降低1–3个数量级，相比模式域检测与模式域ZF/MMSE检测节省约10–15 dB所需SNR，并优于未加扰的模态-时间MMSE均衡器；该优势在扩频带来的频谱效率代价及信道估计与定时误差下仍能保持。渐近分析显示独立分支衰落下达LK倍分集，在秩受限逐抽头衰落信道下可获得收集能量。
AI.tldr: 该文将OAM波束多径散射导致的模式间干扰重新视为可收集的结构化资源，通过时间域正交扩频编码与二维（模式-时延）Rake接收联合合并，显著降低BER并节省10–15 dB SNR。

item.summary: Orbital angular momentum (OAM) beams provide a spatial-multiplexing dimension for wireless communications, but multipath scattering broadens their mode spectrum, so that energy leaks across modes as inter-mode interference (IMI), which conventional OAM demultiplexing discards. This paper treats the leaked modal energy not as interference but as a structured, harvestable resource: it attains up to $LK$-fold asymptotic diversity under independent-branch fading and yields harvested energy under the rank-limited per-tap fading of the operating channel. Each active OAM mode is colored with a distinct time-domain orthogonal spreading code, and a two-dimensional (2D) receiver grid spanning the OAM modes and the resolvable multipath delays jointly combines the despread outputs. The design builds on the Bessel order-difference coupling law of tilted OAM beams, summarized by a Gaussian mode-diffusion model with a mode-coherence metric that quantifies the surviving orthogonality, and on an effective diversity metric that separates the combining gain available at finite signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) from the asymptotic diversity order. At 28~GHz, with a four-mode eight-element uniform circular array (UCA) and four resolvable multipath taps, the proposed 2D modal-time Rake lowers the bit-error rate (BER) by one to three orders of magnitude and saves roughly 10--15~dB of required SNR over mode-wise detection and mode-domain zero-forcing (ZF) and minimum mean-square error (MMSE) detection, and it also outperforms an uncolored modal-time MMSE equalizer; the advantage survives the spectral-efficiency cost of spreading as well as channel-estimation and timing imperfections.
item.title: From Interference to Diversity: Mode Coloring and Two-Dimensional Modal-Time Rake Combining for Multipath OAM Communications

AI.conclusion: DP-SSB可在复用现有SSB资源的同时兼顾低复杂度IoT同步与常规UE兼容性，但代价是DMRS位置调整对UE侧信道估计与PBCH性能的轻微影响。
AI.method: 将选定DMRS符号连续映射到DP-SSB第二、四符号的部分PRB，采用接收机感知的最小二乘（LS）优化以在IoT前端形成特定时域结构；IoT侧经窄带滤波与抽取后进行能量检测和序贯时频同步，UE侧保留PSS/SSS同步并评估DMRS搬移对信道估计与PBCH接收的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有SSB无法被窄带、低复杂度、低功耗IoT设备用于同步，需要在不影响常规UE运行的前提下实现IoT同步。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于物理层同步信号与接收机设计，涉及DMRS搬移对信道估计和PBCH的影响，但核心是IoT同步而非CSI获取/反馈或AI方法。
AI.result: 仿真验证了检测概率的解析表征，DP-SSB在低功耗IoT同步性能上优于基准方案，且维持常规UE的PBCH解码运行。
AI.tldr: 提出双用途SSB（DP-SSB），通过重映射并优化DMRS符号使窄带低功耗IoT设备复用现有SSB完成同步，同时不影响常规UE的PSS/SSS同步与PBCH解码。

item.summary: The synchronization signal block (SSB) is designed to synchronize a capable user-equipment (UE) with the base-station (BS) in recent cellular networks. However, the same SSB cannot be utilized by a narrowband, low-complexity, and low-power internet of things (IoT) device for synchronization. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a dual-purpose SSB (DP-SSB) to enable low-complexity IoT synchronization using the existing SSB, while ensuring uninterrupted conventional UE operation. Specifically, selected demodulation reference signal (DMRS) symbols are contiguously mapped to some physical resource blocks (PRBs) in the second and fourth symbols of the DP-SSB. These DMRS symbols are further optimized using a receiver-aware least square (LS) approach to impose a distinct time-domain structure at the output of the IoT front-end. At the IoT receiver, a reduced-rate observation of the DP-SSB is obtained after narrowband filtering and decimation that is exploited for energy detection and sequential time-frequency (TF) synchronization. For the UE, primary synchronization signal (PSS) and secondary synchronization signal (SSS)-based synchronization is preserved, while the effect of relocated DMRS on the channel estimation and physical broadcast channel (PBCH) reception is assessed. The performance of the proposed DP-SSB is evaluated in terms of detection probability, TF synchronization accuracy, IoT receiver computational complexity, and UE-side PBCH decoding. Simulation results validate the analytical detection characterization and demonstrate reliable low-power IoT synchronization performance compared with the benchmark synchronization schemes while maintaining conventional UE operation.
item.title: Dual-Purpose SSB Design for Joint Time-Frequency Synchronization Using Relocated DMRS

AI.conclusion: 准谐波建模方法的精度瓶颈源于模型阶数，采用高阶建模结合LM优化可显著提升正弦分量参数估计与信号建模精度，但其验证局限于仿真与语音信号，尚未涉及无线信道或CSI场景。
AI.method: 从频率失配角度重新审视QHM方法，揭示其性能本质受模型阶数约束（线性模型无法刻画高阶频率变化）；提出高阶建模框架以更精确逼近信号分量，对优化问题进行定性刻画，并采用Levenberg-Marquardt算法估计幅度、频率与相位参数。
AI.motivation: 已知频率时幅值估计是线性可解问题，但现有方法的频率失配限制了建模精度；QHM及aQHM、eaQHM虽能联合精化频率与幅值，但其提取与校正能力仍受限，作者希望从频率失配视角重新审视并突破该限制。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文研究语音/一般正弦信号的准谐波参数估计，虽涉及频率-幅值联合估计与抗噪优化，但未涉及CSI、信道估计/反馈、MIMO/RIS或无线物理层AI，与研究方向关联很弱。
AI.result: 在仿真研究和语音信号上的实验表明，高阶模型在频率精化与参数提取上优于现有方法，并在加性噪声条件下保持鲁棒性。
AI.tldr: 该论文针对正弦信号参量估计中的频率失配问题，指出准谐波建模（QHM）系列方法受限于线性模型阶数，无法捕获高阶频率变化，进而提出高阶建模框架并用Levenberg-Marquardt算法求解，在仿真与语音信号上验证了幅值、频率、相位估计精度与抗噪鲁棒性。

item.comment: This manuscript is currently under review for publication in the IEEE Transactions on Signal Processing. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
item.summary: Although the amplitude estimation of sinusoids is a linear and tractable problem when their frequencies are known, the accuracy of signal modeling is fundamentally limited by the inevitable frequency mismatches produced by existing methods. Quasi-harmonic modeling (QHM) and its extensions (aQHM and eaQHM) offer the ability to refine frequency estimates while extracting amplitudes; however, their extraction and correction capabilities remain limited. In this paper, we first revisit QHM methods from the perspective of frequency mismatches, and reveal that their performances are essentially constrained by the order of the model. Specifically, QHM methods are linear models and thus incapable of capturing higher-order frequency variations, leading to suboptimal modeling accuracy. Second, to address this limitation, we propose a higher-order modeling framework that enables more precise approximation of signal components. Eventually, we qualitatively characterize the optimization problem and employ the Levenberg--Marquardt (LM) algorithm for parameter estimation. As a result, the proposed method allows for significantly improved estimation of amplitudes, frequencies, and phases of sinusoidal components, enabling more accurate signal modeling. Experiments on both simulation study and speech signals demonstrate the superiority of the high-order model in frequency refinement and parameter extraction and its robustness under additive noise conditions.
item.title: High-Order Sinusoidal Modeling for Precise Parameter Refinement

AI.conclusion: PCS的作用超出EISL调节范畴，可用于逐码字ISLR的精确控制；OFDM在此方面具有近乎唯一的适用性；所提方法为ISAC波形设计提供了兼顾感知约束与通信速率的实用方案。
AI.method: 从理论上分析类型化PCS（type-based PCS）对OFDM逐码字ISLR的控制能力，证明OFDM几乎是唯一可通过类型化PCS精确控制逐码字ISLR的酉调制基；在此基础上设计兼容概率幅度整形（PAS）框架的实用类型化PCS方法，并在相同ISLR约束下与现有ISAC导向PCS方法对比通信速率。
AI.motivation: PCS原用于弥合有限均匀星座与连续容量可达输入分布之间的差距，近年被用于调节ISAC中的期望积分旁瓣电平（EISL）。作者希望超越EISL层面的统计控制，实现更精细、更强的感知性能保证。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦ISAC中的概率星座整形与OFDM旁瓣电平控制，属于物理层调制/波形设计，未涉及CSI获取、信道估计、CSI反馈压缩或信道知识建模，与研究方向联系薄弱。
AI.result: 类型化PCS可对OFDM逐码字ISLR提供精确控制，给出比EISL控制更强的感知性能保证；所提兼容PAS的实用方法在相同ISLR约束下实现比现有ISAC导向PCS方法更高的通信速率。
AI.tldr: 该论文研究概率星座整形（PCS）在ISAC中的应用，提出"类型化PCS"可在OFDM系统中精确控制逐码字积分旁瓣比（ISLR），并获得比EISL控制更强的感知性能保证，进而设计了兼容PAS框架的实用PCS方法。

item.summary: Probabilistic constellation shaping (PCS), originally designed to fill the gap between finite uniform constellations and continuous capacity-achieving input distributions, has recently emerged as a central tool in adjusting the expected integrated sidelobe level (EISL) in integrated sensing and communication (ISAC). In this paper, we show that PCS goes beyond EISL: A large class of PCS methods, termed as type-based PCS, are capable of providing precise control over codeword-wise integrated sidelobe level ratio (ISLR) for systems employing orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM), thus yielding a stronger sensing performance guarantee than EISL control. We further show that OFDM is almost the only unitary modulation basis whose codeword-wise ISLR can be precisely controlled by type-based PCS. Based upon the analytical results, practical type-based PCS methods compatible with the probabilistic amplitude shaping (PAS) framework are conceived, which achieve higher communication rates than existing ISAC-oriented PCS methods under identical ISLR constraints.
item.title: How Does Probabilistic Constellation Shaping Control Ranging Sidelobe Levels in ISAC?

AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一种无标签估计听觉注意力时间波动的途径，证明了概率化时间推断在单说话人场景下连续注意力跟踪中的有效性。
AI.method: 将神经包络追踪（NET）作为观测特征，与隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）时间推断相结合，构建完全无监督的aAAD流程；使用30名成人EEG数据，考察分析窗长影响，并将HMM后处理与滑动平均（MA）平滑及alpha功率、谱熵等替代EEG特征进行对比。
AI.motivation: 绝对听觉注意力解码缺乏竞争语音参考，难以实现可靠的注意力跟踪，且现有方法多依赖显式注意力状态标签，因此需要一种无标签的连续注意力轨迹估计方法。
AI.relevance_reason: 该论文属于听觉神经科学与脑电信号处理中的注意力解码，虽涉及包络追踪与HMM时序推断，但研究对象为EEG听觉注意力而非无线CSI/信道估计、压缩、反馈或信道知识建模，与研究画像关联微弱。
AI.result: 1秒分析窗下非因果HMM后处理使全部30名被试AUC均提升，平均AUC由原始NET的0.547升至0.832；5秒窗取得最高平均AUC 0.858；在所考察的平滑尺度上HMM优于MA平滑；个体切换检测时间相当，但HMM组级检测时间更短；NET作为HMM观测特征优于alpha功率与谱熵。
AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种无监督的绝对听觉注意力解码（aAAD）流程，将神经包络追踪（NET）与基于隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）的时间推断相结合，在无注意力状态标签的条件下从EEG与目标语音包络中估计连续的注意力轨迹，30名被试实验中1秒窗口下平均AUC从0.547提升至0.832，5秒窗口达0.858。

item.summary: Objective: Absolute auditory attention decoding (aAAD) aims to track how strongly a listener attends to a single speech source using electroencephalography (EEG). Unlike selective auditory attention decoding, aAAD lacks a competing speech reference, making reliable attention tracking challenging. Approach: We propose a fully unsupervised aAAD pipeline combining neural envelope tracking (NET) with hidden Markov model (HMM)-based temporal inference. Using EEG signals and the target speech envelope, the framework estimates a continuous attention trajectory without explicit attention-state labels. We evaluate the approach using EEG recordings from 30 adults, investigate the impact of analysis window length, and compare HMM post-processing with moving-average (MA) smoothing and alternative EEG features. Main results: With 1-s analysis windows, non-causal HMM post-processing improves the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) for all 30 participants, increasing mean AUC from 0.547 for raw NET to 0.832. A 5-s window achieves the highest mean AUC of 0.858. Compared with non-causal MA smoothing, the HMM achieves higher AUC across the examined smoothing scales. Individual switch detection times are comparable, while the HMM generally achieves lower group-level detection times. NET also outperforms alpha power and spectral entropy as an observation feature in the unsupervised HMM framework. Significance: The proposed framework provides a label-free approach for estimating temporal fluctuations in auditory attention, demonstrating the utility of probabilistic temporal inference for continuous attention tracking in single-speaker listening scenarios.
item.title: A hidden Markov model for unsupervised EEG-based tracking of auditory attention to a single voice

AI.conclusion: 本文给出了高斯位置混合Fisher信息的通用下界及其均值估计应用，揭示least favorable先验的支撑复杂度，并通过I-MMSE框架关联MMSE与互信息。
AI.method: 对离散混合分布，用二阶Rényi熵推导PSD下界（尺度~log K/K²）；用经典Sobolev不等式建立维度感知迹界，以Sibson α-互信息表达（尺度K^{-2/n}）；用Young卷积不等式得α=1/2的互补界；并推广到离散球壳上的旋转不变混合分布；最后借助Brown恒等式与I-MMSE关系转化结果。
AI.motivation: 作者希望改进基于Stam不等式得到的下界（支撑集大小依赖），并建立维度感知的Fisher信息下界，以刻画有界高斯均值估计中的least favorable先验结构。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究了估计问题中与信道估计相关的信息论下界和I-MMSE工具，但均为纯理论，不涉及CSI获取、反馈或无线AI方法，与研究方向关联较弱。
AI.result: 得到log K/K²的PSD下界（较Stam改进一个对数因子）；维度n下K^{-2/n}的迹界；球壳情形下以占据壳数表达的Fisher信息下界。标量情形least favorable先验至少有Ω(R√log R)个支撑点、每点概率质量至多~1/R；向量情形占据壳数至少随R线性增长。并给出MMSE与互信息的对应上界。
AI.tldr: 本文研究高斯位置混合分布的Fisher信息下界，基于Rényi熵、Sobolev不等式、Sibson互信息等推导出维度感知的PSD与迹下界，应用于高斯均值估计的least favorable先验，并通过Brown恒等式与I-MMSE关系转化为MMSE和互信息的界。

item.summary: We study lower bounds on the Fisher information of Gaussian location mixtures and their applications to estimation problems. First, for a discrete mixing distribution, we derive a universal positive-semidefinite lower bound on the Fisher information matrix in terms of the Rényi entropy of order two. For a mixing distribution supported on $K$ points, this bound scales as $\log(K)/K^2$, improving by a logarithmic factor on the support-size dependence obtained from Stam's inequality. We then develop dimension-aware trace bounds using classical Sobolev inequalities. These bounds are expressed in terms of Sibson's $\alpha$-mutual information and yield the scaling $K^{-2/n}$ in dimension $n$. A complementary bound involving the $\alpha$-mutual information of order $1/2$ is obtained using the sharp Young convolution inequality. The derived inequalities are further specialized to rotationally invariant mixing distributions supported on discrete spherical shells. In this setting, an intrinsic-dimensional bound on Sibson mutual information leads to lower bounds on the Fisher information in terms of the number of occupied shells. As applications, we study least favorable priors for bounded Gaussian mean estimation. In the scalar case, we show that the least favorable prior on $[-R,R]$ has at least $\Omega(R\sqrt{\log R})$ support points and that each of its probability masses is of order at most $1/R$. In the vector case, we show that the number of occupied shells grows at least linearly with $R$. Finally, Brown's identity and the I-MMSE relationship are used to translate the Fisher-information inequalities into upper bounds on the MMSE and mutual information.
item.title: Fisher Information and Support Complexity of Gaussian Mixtures

AI.conclusion: 将边界长度解耦并交由CNN联合波形与软输出进行检测，可在不改变译码器的前提下显著缩短边界，提高有效载荷效率，代价是碰撞暴露与检测性能之间的权衡。
AI.method: 将边界长度作为独立设计参数，设计卷积神经网络，输入为接收波形（输入尺寸随边界长度减小）与译码器软输出（保持码字长度），据此联合检测起始与结束边界；并通过分析与仿真量化权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有译码辅助接收机使用与一个码字等长的起始与尾部序列，对短命令造成显著开销，因此需要缩短边界序列而不影响译码器。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文属于物理层AI接收机设计，使用CNN处理接收波形与软输出，但与CSI获取、信道估计、CSI反馈压缩或信道知识建模无直接关联。
AI.result: 仿真表明所提接收机可利用极短边界：在测试设置下最短边界L_b=16在所有测试负载下取得最高有效载荷效率，而同序列的相关基准在中高负载下需L_b=64才表现最佳。
AI.tldr: 该论文将异步免授权接入中的边界序列长度视为独立设计参数，提出一种CNN接收机，联合利用接收波形与译码器软输出检测传输的起始与结束边界，并分析边界长度在有效载荷效率、碰撞暴露与边界检测之间的权衡。

item.summary: In asynchronous grant-free access, receivers must detect variable-length transmissions and identify their start and end. Existing decoder-aided receivers use start and tail sequences which are as long as one codeword, causing substantial overhead for short commands. This paper treats the boundary (i.e., start and tail sequences) length as an independent design parameter and proposes a convolutional neural network that detects both boundaries from the received waveform and the decoder soft output. Its waveform input size decreases with the boundary length, while the decoder input keeps the codeword length, so the boundary can be shortened without altering the decoder. Analysis and simulations quantify the resulting tradeoff among payload efficiency, collision exposure, and boundary detection. The results show that the proposed receiver can exploit very short boundaries: in the considered setting, the shortest tested boundary, $L_{\mathrm{b}}=16$, yields the highest effective payload efficiency at all tested loads, whereas a correlation-based benchmark with the same sequences performs best with $L_{\mathrm{b}}=64$ at moderate and high loads.
item.title: Short-Boundary Signaling for Asynchronous Grant-Free Control-to-Control Communications

AI.conclusion: SA-OFDM-IM 在光无线系统中验证了索引调制与感知导频复用结合能量分配的可行性，能够在低复杂度检测下兼顾通信 BER 与定位/信道估计性能，但对射频 MIMO/CSI 反馈等主流场景的迁移性需进一步评估。
AI.method: 多层频域架构将每层可用子载波划分为通信与分布式感知导频两个不相交子集，在通信子集内做分组索引调制；采用受限的感知-通信能量分配在最小功率裕度约束下联合最小化 BER 与基于时延的定位 RMSE；帧内聚合感知音重建信道频响，提取 LoS 时延抽头与相位补偿的 LoS 增益用于多边定位，并融合时延辅助的 RSS 精化；接收端采用有序能量检测替代穷举 ML。
AI.motivation: 面向光无线（OWC）场景的联合通信与定位需求，希望在有限能量与低调开销下同时降低误码率与定位时延 RMSE，并避免穷举最大似然检测的高复杂度。
AI.relevance_reason: 涉及OFDM信道频响重建与时延辅助信道估计，属CSI获取邻近问题，但场景为光无线并聚焦定位与索引调制，AI成分薄弱。
AI.result: 相较 DC-biased optical OFDM，BER 所需 SNR 最多降低约 5 dB，信道估计误差最多低约三个数量级；RSS 估计器消除了仅时延与混合 RSS 基准中与 SNR 无关的误差下限，达到亚时延 bin 的距离与位置精度，并在已知/未知随机接收机朝向条件下保持鲁棒。
AI.tldr: 提出 sensing-assisted OFDM-IM (SA-OFDM-IM) 用于光无线系统的联合通信与定位，利用分层子载波划分与索引调制、能量分配联合优化 BER 与定位 RMSE，并以聚合感知导频重建信道频响，实现低复杂度有序能量检测。

item.summary: This paper proposes sensing-assisted OFDM with index modulation (SA-OFDM-IM) for joint communication and localisation over optical wireless systems. In SA-OFDM-IM, a multilayer frequency-domain architecture partitions each layer's admissible subcarriers into disjoint communication and distributed sensing-pilot subsets, applying group-wise index modulation (IM) within the communication subset. A constrained sensing-to-communication energy allocation jointly minimises average bit-error rate (BER) and delay-based localisation root mean square error (RMSE) under a minimum power-domain margin, enabling low-complexity, ordered-energy detection of both sensing and communication subcarriers without exhaustive maximum-likelihood search. Sensing tones are aggregated across the frame to reconstruct the channel frequency response, yielding the line-of-sight (LoS) delay tap and phase-compensated LoS gain for multilateration and, via the proposed delay-aided received signal strength (RSS) refinement. Simulation results indicate that SA-OFDM-IM can achieve up to 5 dB lower SNR requirement in BER and up to three orders of magnitude lower channel-estimation error than DC-biased optical OFDM, while the RSS estimator removes the SNR-independent error floors of delay-only and hybrid-RSS benchmarks to attain sub-delay-bin range and position accuracy, remaining robust under random known and unknown receiver orientations.
item.title: Sensing-Assisted OFDM with Index Modulation: A Waveform for Optical Wireless Integrated Communication and Localisation

AI.conclusion: 该工作将模型驱动的深度学习与低比特分布式检测结合，通过理论刻画与可训练概率量化器及MAP融合规则，在有限带宽与统计未知场景下实现接近最优的检测性能与较好的泛化鲁棒性。
AI.method: 模型驱动深度学习框架：对固定本地量化器推导有限传感器MAP检测误差，并证明在条件独立同分布观测、独立本地随机化与共同量化级约束下相同量化器保持平均网络Chernoff信息的上确界；据此设计带可训练神经概率控制器的二元概率量化器与树结构多比特概率量化器；以精确MAP误差作为二元量化器训练目标，为多比特量化器推导可计算的Bhattacharyya替代目标；基于量化消息的类条件PMF推导解析MAP融合规则，统计未知时用留出标注数据估计PMF形成plug-in MAP检测器。
AI.motivation: 大规模网络中分布式协作推理需在带宽受限下进行极低位量化，低比特量化会显著降低检测性能，尤其在观测噪声先验未知时，因此需要在低比特量化条件下提升分布式检测性能。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文属于分布式检测与量化通信的物理层AI方法，与量化、低比特消息和统计未知下的鲁棒性有可迁移方法关联，但不涉及CSI获取、信道估计、CSI反馈压缩或信道知识建模，故仅弱相关。
AI.result: 仿真表明所提方法在较高量化分辨率下接近集中式oracle性能，并在网络规模和测试时信号幅度变化下仍保持有效。
AI.tldr: 提出模型驱动的深度学习框架用于低比特量化下的分布式检测，推导有限传感器MAP误差与Chernoff信息结论，设计二元/树结构概率量化器及基于PMF的MAP融合规则，在统计未知时用留出数据估计PMF，仿真接近集中式oracle性能并具鲁棒性。

item.comment: 16 pages, 10 figures. Accepted by IEEE JSAC
item.summary: Distributed detection plays a fundamental role in communication-efficient collaborative inference over large-scale networks, where spatially distributed nodes must cooperate using severely quantized messages due to bandwidth constraints. While low-bit quantization is essential for reducing communication overhead, it can significantly degrade detection performance, particularly when prior knowledge of observation noise is unavailable. To address this challenge, we propose a model-driven deep learning framework for distributed detection with low-bit quantization. For fixed local quantizers, we first derive the exact finite-sensor maximum a posteriori (MAP) detection error and prove that, under conditionally independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) observations, independent local randomizations, and a common quantization-level constraint, identical quantizers preserve the supremum of the average network Chernoff information. Guided by these results, we develop a binary probabilistic quantizer with a trainable neural probability controller and design a tree-structured probabilistic quantizer for scalable multi-bit quantization. The exact finite-sensor MAP error provides the training objective for the binary quantizer, while we derive a computationally tractable Bhattacharyya surrogate objective for training the multi-bit quantizer. For both cases, we derive analytical MAP fusion rules based on the class-conditional probability mass functions (PMFs) of the quantized messages. When the observation statistics are unknown, these PMFs are estimated from held-out labeled data, yielding plug-in MAP detectors. Simulation results show that the proposed method approaches centralized-oracle performance at higher quantization resolutions and remains effective under changes in network size and test-time signal amplitude.
item.title: Model-Driven Deep Learning for Distributed Detection with Low-Bit Quantization

AI.conclusion: LRA作为联合指标与边缘准确率/安全指标存在本质差异，需针对性优化；该框架可为语义感知远程监控的传输策略与地理围栏约束设计提供分析工具。
AI.method: 在随机平稳(RS)传输与两端零阶保持重构下，针对一般有限状态遍历马尔可夫源推导联合平稳分布及LRA概率与持续性的闭式表达；对两状态与均匀转移源给出代数表达式以支持低复杂度RS策略优化；并进行稀有传输分析与地理围栏应用映射。
AI.motivation: 在语义感知远程监控中，更新可能被窃听者截获，需要同时保证合法接收端的重构准确性与安全性；而源状态演化使两接收端更新的相关性变化，使得边缘重构准确率无法决定联合事件概率，因此需要专门刻画该联合指标。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦语义通信远程监控的重构准确性与窃听安全问题，属于网络/语义通信与安全范畴，未涉及CSI获取、信道估计、反馈压缩或信道知识建模。
AI.result: 最大化LRA概率未必最大化其持续性；两状态下在转移概率和固定时，更强的转移不对称性可提高持续性但降低LRA概率；优化边缘准确率与安全指标可能选出对LRA次优的策略；更频繁传输或提升合法信道可靠性可提高合法重构准确率却降低LRA概率；并将LRA需求转化为对窃听者位置的空间约束。
AI.tldr: 研究语义感知远程监控中合法接收端与窃听端的联合重构准确性与安全性，定义合法重构优势(LRA)并推导其概率与持续性的闭式表达，进而优化随机平稳传输策略。

item.summary: This paper investigates joint accuracy and security in semantics-aware remote monitoring, where source updates intended for a legitimate receiver may also be intercepted by an eavesdropper. We define legitimate reconstruction advantage (LRA) as the joint event that the intended receiver correctly reconstructs the current source state using received updates while the eavesdropper reconstructs it incorrectly. Source evolution changes the relevance of received updates at the two receivers, so their marginal reconstruction accuracies do not, in general, determine the probability of this joint event. Under randomized stationary (RS) transmission and zero-order-hold reconstruction at both receivers, we derive an explicit joint stationary distribution and closed-form expressions for LRA probability and persistence for general finite-state ergodic Markov sources. For two-state and uniform-transition sources, we obtain algebraic expressions that enable low-complexity optimization of RS policies. Analytical and numerical results show that maximizing the probability of legitimate advantage need not maximize its persistence. For two-state sources, rare-transmission analysis reveals that, at a fixed sum of transition probabilities, greater transition asymmetry can increase persistence while reducing LRA probability. Moreover, optimizing marginal accuracy and security metrics can select policies that are suboptimal for LRA. Counterintuitively, more frequent transmission or improved legitimate-channel reliability can increase legitimate reconstruction accuracy while reducing LRA probability. Finally, a geofencing application translates prescribed LRA requirements into spatial constraints on eavesdropper locations.
item.title: Legitimate Reconstruction Advantage in Wiretapped Semantics-Aware Remote Monitoring

AI.conclusion: 置信度校准驱动的自适应波束候选选择可在不增加开销、不重训练预测器的前提下有效提升mmWave波束跟踪精度与链路可靠性。
AI.method: 视觉辅助mmWave波束跟踪中，对预测器输出logits做温度校准，在最大预算约束下保留累计概率达到目标阈值的最小top-ranked波束集合，实现自适应候选选择，无需重训练预测器。
AI.motivation: 固定top-K选择对所有预测样本和预测时域分配相同候选波束预算，忽略了样本间与时间维度上的不确定性差异，导致开销利用低效。
AI.relevance_reason: 涉及mmWave波束跟踪与视觉辅助预测，属于无线物理层AI范畴，但重点是波束选择策略与置信度校准，未直接涉及CSI获取、信道估计或CSI反馈压缩。
AI.result: 在DeepSense 6G Scenario 8上，五个随机种子、相同开销条件下，候选集准确率最高提升3.80个百分点，归一化接收功率提升0.32个百分点，中断概率降低2.06个百分点。
AI.tldr: 提出置信度引导的自适应候选波束选择方法，通过对预测器logits进行温度校准，保留累计概率达标的最小波束集合，在固定开销下提升mmWave波束跟踪性能。

item.summary: Vision-aided beam tracking reduces mmWave beam-training overhead by predicting beam indices from camera observations. Fixed top-$K$ selection, however, assigns the same candidate beam budget to all predictions, ignoring uncertainty variations across samples and horizons. This letter proposes confidence-guided adaptive candidate selection: predictor logits are temperature-calibrated, and the smallest top-ranked beam set whose cumulative probability reaches a target threshold is retained under a maximum budget. On DeepSense~6G Scenario~8, over five random seeds and at matched overhead, the policy improves candidate set accuracy by up to 3.80 percentage points, increases normalized received power by 0.32 percentage points, and reduces outage probability by 2.06 percentage points without retraining the predictor.
item.title: Confidence-Guided Adaptive Beam Selection for Vision-Aided Beam Tracking in mmWave Systems

AI.conclusion: 在MUMT MIMO-OFDM ISAC系统中，二维ISLR对波束成形不变，而零多普勒PSLR可通过平坦化方向功率谱来控制；基于CV的凸松弛可在极小和速率损失下大幅提升计算效率。
AI.method: 统计刻画离散周期模糊函数(DP-AF)，推导精确闭式期望旁瓣电平(ESL)；分析非零多普勒ESL切片与二维ISLR的波束成形不变性；针对可控的零多普勒PSLR，证明kurtosis>1时PSLR最大化当且仅当各目标方向功率谱在子载波上平坦，引入变异系数(CV)度量偏离度并推导CV相关的PSLR上下界，用下界构造凸充分约束，形成AF感知的联合波束成形与子载波分配问题的高效重构。
AI.motivation: ISAC中随机通信符号使模糊函数依赖于数据，难以刻画并纳入发射端设计，因此需要明确在实用多用户多目标MIMO-OFDM系统中哪些AF特性可通过波束成形有效控制。

item.summary: Ambiguity function (AF) characterizes the delay--Doppler sidelobe structure that governs target resolution and masking in radar sensing. In ISAC, however, random communication symbols make the AF data-dependent, complicating its characterization and incorporation into transmit design. This raises a fundamental question: which AF characteristic can be effectively controlled through beamforming in a practical multiuser multitarget (MUMT) MIMO--OFDM system? To answer this, we statistically characterize the discrete-periodic AF (DP-AF) and derive an exact closed-form expected sidelobe level (ESL). We observe that nonzero-Doppler ESL cuts are delay-flat and the full two-dimensional integrated sidelobe level ratio (ISLR) is invariant to beamforming, whereas the zero-Doppler peak-to-sidelobe ratio (PSLR) remains controllable. We accordingly formulate an AF-aware joint beamforming and subcarrier-allocation problem with target-wise PSLR and illumination constraints. Since the direct PSLR constraint is intractable, we characterize its global optimum and prove that, for symbol kurtosis greater than one, the PSLR is maximized if and only if each target-wise directional-power profile is flat across subcarriers. We then introduce the coefficient of variation (CV) to measure deviation from this flatness and derive tight CV-dependent PSLR bounds. The lower bound yields a convex sufficient constraint for a desired PSLR, enabling an efficient reformulation. Simulations show $9.4$--$11.0$ dB worst-case PSLR gains over communication-only beamforming at the flat-spectrum point with a $2.4$--$5.9\%$ sum-rate loss. The CV-relaxed formulation achieves $99.7\%$ of the average sum-rate of the original PSLR-constrained problem, while reducing runtime by factors of $10.35$--$12.15$ under the considered scenarios.
item.title: Statistical Ambiguity-Function-Aware Joint Beamforming and Subcarrier Allocation for MIMO-OFDM ISAC under Random Symbols

item.summary: In integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) systems, communication and sensing share time-frequency resources, creating a fundamental trade-off between communication quality of service (QoS) and quality of sensing (QoSe). Reusing 5G new radio (NR) reference signals (RSs) enables standard-compliant sensing, but their inherent sparsity leads to undersampled channels and strong sidelobes that degrade weak-target detection. Compressed sensing (CS) can mitigate these effects, yet existing methods either overlook communication QoS constraints or rely on reconstruction algorithms that are step-size-sensitive or employ global thresholding, leading to weak-target masking in multi-target scenarios. The multi-target detection problem, therefore, requires a joint design of resource scheduling and CS-based reconstruction. In this work, we investigate the impact of two scheduling schemes, namely QoS-guaranteed scheduling and proportional-fairness (PF)-based scheduling, on the sensing-communication trade-off. To further enhance sensing performance, we employ a 2D max-median complex approximate message passing (2D-mmCAMP) algorithm that performs adaptive row- and column-wise thresholding to suppress sidelobes while preserving weak-target responses in multi-target scenarios. Simulations demonstrate an improvement of >= 16% in weak-target detection over baseline reconstruction algorithms while meeting downlink (DL) QoS constraints, validating the effectiveness of the proposed NR-compliant ISAC scheme.
item.title: Seeing Through Sparse Signals: CS-Enhanced Sensing With QoS Guarantees for 6G ISAC

item.comment: 18 pages, 16 figures, 3 tables. This paper has been accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing
item.summary: The convergence of communication and computation, empowered by artificial intelligence (AI) enhanced capabilities, emerges as a key enabler for realizing the promising functionalities of the sixth-generation of communication systems (6G). To this end, this paper investigates an AI-native, robust network, where multiple base stations (BSs) simultaneously serve several extended reality (XR) devices. The paper then presents an innovative distributed deep learning-based approach to simultaneously manage the transmit and computing powers, and computation allocation, amidst uncertainties in both channel and computing states information. Under such an interference network scenario, the paper proposes a robust approach for minimizing the worst-case delay across the served XR devices, subject to computation and power constraints. The paper leverages a deep neural network (DNN) that can be trained either centrally or in a federated manner to map estimated channels and computation requirements to optimized resource allocations per BS. During training, uncertainty samples, reflecting both channel and computing estimation errors, are injected after the DNN output to account for such joint uncertainties. Our results validate the enhanced robust delay performance and scalability of joint uncertainty injection as compared to uncertainty-agnostic methods and state-of-the-art benchmarks, with federated learning-based solutions achieving near-centralized performance while enhancing efficiency, privacy, and adaptability.
item.title: Uncertainty-Aware Federated Learning for Joint Communication and Computation in XR Systems

item.summary: This paper studies the design of some high-rate, adaptive, low-density parity-check (LDPC) convolutional codes with short constraint length, based on interleaved parity-check polynomials. Starting from some known results regarding the selection of polynomials that yield codes free of short cycles in the associated Tanner graphs, we propose some new constructions based on Golomb rulers, along with relaxed variants that do not strictly satisfy the Golomb ruler condition, but retain similar structural properties. The result is a family of rate-adaptive code constructions with code rates of the form $R=(n_0-1)/n_0$. Conditions for the absence of length-4 cycles are derived, together with upper bounds on the free distance that are met in all considered examples.
item.title: Design of a Family of Rate-Adaptive LDPC Convolutional Codes with Short Constraint Length

item.summary: In this paper, we consider a discrete-time pull-based remote estimation system involving an information source and a remote monitor where the information source is a finite-state irreducible discrete-time Markov chain (DTMC) process. In this system, the remote monitor sends a pull request towards the source which responds by sampling its process so as to transmit the sampled values towards the monitor through a delay channel, encapsulated in information packets. We consider i) zero delay (ZD) and ii) unit delay (UD) channels, where the packet transmission times are zero and one slot, respectively. For remote estimation, we use the maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimator, and for quantifying its performance, we use the mean age of incorrect information (MAoII) which is a recently proposed freshness and mismatch metric that penalizes an incorrect estimation along with its duration. Our goal is to obtain pull policies so as to minimize MAoII under a long-run sampling rate constraint. For the ZD model, we propose a semi-Markov decision process (SMDP) formulation of the problem, which allows us to find the optimum observation-dependent pull policy. On the other hand, the UD channel prevents the monitor from possessing perfect information on the actual AoII process at any given time, and the SMDP formulation of the ZD channel cannot readily be used for the UD model. For the system with the UD channel, we first provide a numerical algorithm to calculate the MAoII and the average sampling rate for a given observation-dependent pull policy. For the optimization of the underlying remote estimation system, we use the joint distribution of the age and source processes to be obtained from the history of all observations, termed as belief. Subsequently, we propose a belief-dependent policy obtained via the belief-MDP formulation and a constrained deep reinforcement learning (CDRL) algorithm.
item.title: Minimizing Age of Incorrect Information in Pull-Based Remote Estimation of a Markov Source

AI.conclusion: 信息瓶颈问题在一般情况下不存在高效精确或高精度近似算法，这为采用启发式、变分或神经网络近似方法提供了理论依据，也界定了其可解性的理论极限。

AI.motivation: 信息瓶颈方法广泛用于表示学习与压缩，但其计算复杂度此前缺乏严格刻画；作者希望明确该基本问题的理论可计算性边界，以说明精确或近似求解的固有困难。
AI.relevance_reason: 该论文研究信息瓶颈的复杂度理论，属于信息论与机器学习交叉，但未涉及无线CSI、信道估计、反馈压缩或物理层AI等具体无线问题，仅与神经压缩/表示学习有间接概念联系。

item.summary: Given a joint distribution $P_{XY}$ on a finite alphabet, the information bottleneck method seeks a representation $T$ of $X$ that is as informative as possible about $Y$ while compressing $X$, where $T$ and $Y$ are conditionally independent given $X$. We show that computing the optimal value $\mathrm{IB}(P_{XY},R) = \sup_T \{ I(Y;T) : I(X;T) \le R \}$ of the information bottleneck problem, as well as its Lagrangian relaxation $L_{\beta}(P_{XY}) = \sup_T \big[I(Y;T) - \beta I(X;T)\big]$, is NP-hard. Moreover, unless $\mathrm{P} = \mathrm{NP}$, neither $\mathrm{IB}(P_{XY},R)$ nor $L_{\beta}(P_{XY})$ can be approximated in polynomial time within an additive error of order $|\mathcal{X}|^{-3/2}$.
item.title: The Information Bottleneck is NP-hard

item.summary: We study transmission scheduling in an energy-harvesting actuation system where an actuation requires both a received update and available energy. While age of information (AoI) measures information freshness, age of actuation (AoA) measures the time elapsed since the latest completed actuation. The transmitter observes the receiver's AoA and battery state and decides whether to transmit a fresh update in each slot. We formulate average-AoA minimization as a Markov decision process and establish an AoA-threshold property for an optimal policy. We also derive the average AoA in closed form under the AoI-optimal policy, which is always-transmit. Numerical results show that AoA-aware scheduling can improve actuation freshness while reducing the number of transmissions, although information freshness may deteriorate. The two policies coincide for some pairs of channel success and energy-arrival probabilities. For a one-unit battery, the transmission rate under the AoA-optimal policy can vary nonmonotonically with the energy-arrival probability.
item.title: When Fresh Information Is Not Enough: Age-of-Actuation-Optimal Scheduling for Energy-Harvesting Actuators

2610.20653.summary: We study the sharp constant in the differential inequality \[ I(t)I''(t)\geq c\,[I'(t)]^2 \] for Fisher information along the probability-normalized heat flow on $\mathbb R^2$. The unrestricted log-convexity value $c=1$ is false in two dimensions, whereas the known square-root convexity theorem gives the universal value $c=1/2$. We construct an exact, machine-verifiable sum-of-squares certificate proving the stronger universal bound \[ c\geq \frac{231691}{250000}=0.926764. \] Together with an independent exact Fourier/Gaussian-envelope construction, this gives \[ 0.926764\leq c_*<0.94176665012062, \] where $c_*$ is the sharp constant for positive-time Gaussian convolutions of arbitrary probability measures on $\mathbb R^2$. We formulate the proof in explicit two-dimensional index notation. The lower bound follows from an exact rational polynomial identity involving a strictly positive denominator, a weighted total derivative, and eleven positive rational Gram matrices. All $491$ recorded leading principal minors are strictly positive and the complete polynomial identity has zero residual. No symmetry, log-concavity, finite-variance, or finite-entropy assumption is imposed on the initial measure. The sharp value remains open.
2610.20653.title: An exact computer-assisted lower bound for Fisher-information convexity along the two-dimensional heat flow

2610.20841.comment: We take a step toward wireless networks that can compute as well as communicate, using analog RF computing to deliver AI inference to resource-constrained edge devices while simultaneously serving conventional data transmission. This is a follow-up to our analog RF computing framework: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14331. To be presented at IEEE Globecom 2026
2610.20841.summary: Many resource-constrained edge devices require artificial intelligence (AI) services but are not powerful enough to store or execute neural networks (NNs). Analog radio frequency (RF) computing addresses this limitation by letting a base station (BS) multicast a waveform encoding NN weights to different clients. Each client then multiplies the received weight-encoded waveform with its locally generated input-encoded waveform through a passive mixer in its RF frontend, thereby realizing the matrix-vector multiplications (MVMs) needed for AI inference with an extremely low power and memory requirement. This can enable telecom operators to provide AI inference services to the edge devices connected to their networks. In practice, however, this multicast AI flow must share the spectrum, power, and spatial resources with other data flows. This paper considers a multi-user multiple-input multiple-output (MU-MIMO) downlink scenario and studies the resulting relative aggregate data rate reduction from integrating the multicast AI flow with the unicast data flows. We formulate a joint beamforming problem for the data and AI flows to maximize the aggregate data rate subject to computing accuracy, client energy, total power, and hardware-related constraints. We develop a weighted minimum mean-square error (WMMSE)-based algorithm to solve the problem. Numerical results based on 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) channels show that the relative aggregate data rate reduction from integrating an AI flow with data flows is below 5% in representative settings. This indicates that telecom operators can use analog RF computing to provide edge AI services while providing data communication services simultaneously.
2610.20841.title: Analog RF Computing for Integrated Data and AI Flows Over Wireless Networks

2610.20876.summary: A Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework is proposed for quickest change detection (QCD) where there are multiple experts, and each expert produces a sequence of statistics for change detection. A change is declared when a weighted sum of these statistics crosses a threshold. This framework is then applied to the problem of multi-stream QCD to obtain a family of powerful algorithms that outperform the best known algorithms in the literature. In the multi-stream QCD problem, a decision-maker observes multiple streams of observations. At the change point, the distribution of an unknown subset of the streams changes. The optimal algorithm based on a generalized likelihood ratio is computationally expensive. One of the most computationally and performance-efficient algorithms in the literature is the rank-weighted sum (RWS) scheme based on Shiryaev-Roberts statistics. It is shown in the paper that the MoE-based QCD algorithm for multi-stream data outperforms the RWS scheme. This is demonstrated through simulation results on real-valued Gaussian mean shift data and high-dimensional data from Gaussian--Bernoulli Restricted Boltzmann Machines (GB-RBMs).
2610.20876.title: A Mixture-of-Experts Framework for Multi-Stream Quickest Change Detection

2610.20923.comment: Accepted for presentation at IEEE ISAC 2026
2610.20923.summary: This paper considers uplink channel state information (CSI)-based sensing as an opportunistic approach to enabling sensing in cellular networks, with minimum required modifications to the infrastructure. A practical sensing signal processing procedure is presented, combining 5G positioning function with multi-antenna array processing for passive target localization. The approach is validated through simulation and practical experiments with a software-defined radio-based setup, utilizing open-source software frameworks and commercially available hardware components. Results demonstrate feasibility of the uplink CSI-based sensing for detection, localization and tracking of moving targets over local areas.
2610.20923.title: Evolution Toward Sensing-Enabled RAN: Practical Bistatic Sensing via Uplink

2610.20924.summary: This paper proposes a pinching antenna system to enhance the connectivity and efficiency in aerial wireless networks. The algebraic connectivity of the network's graph is maximized by optimizing the placement of the pinching antenna elements in the uplink and downlink waveguides. The number of deployed unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is minimized while maintaining a minimum network connectivity indicator. A heuristic pinching antenna placement algorithm is designed to maximize the network connectivity. An iterative UAV deployment algorithm is also designed to find the minimum number of UAVs, their placement locations, and the pinching antenna placement. Simulation results show that the considered pinching antenna system improves network connectivity and efficiency.
2610.20924.title: Resilient and Efficient Aerial Wireless Sensor Networks Using Pinching-Antenna Systems

2610.20928.comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Vehicular Technology (TVT); currently under review
2610.20928.summary: High pulse repetition frequency (PRF) operation improves Doppler unambiguous sensing but reduces the maximum unambiguous range of a terahertz (THz) pulsed radar. Echoes from targets beyond this range can be incorrectly associated with subsequent transmitted pulses, causing the targets to appear at shorter ranges. This paper proposes a receiver-side framework that exploits the THz-specific temporal broadening effect as a distance-dependent signature to resolve range ambiguity. For each detected echo, the receiver applies broadening-matched filtering with references corresponding to candidate target ranges. The filter outputs are combined across pulses with Doppler compensation, and the largest normalised combined response identifies the ambiguity order needed to recover the true target range. The selected reference is then reused to reduce mismatch loss in subsequent range and velocity estimation. Simulations under known atmospheric conditions, with targets occupying distinct apparent-delay bins, demonstrate reliable range recovery beyond the conventional unambiguous interval. Range estimation errors conditioned on correct ambiguity-order identification, together with the reported velocity estimation errors, approach their corresponding derived Cramér--Rao bounds. The method preserves a fixed transmitted pulse shape, PRF, and sampling rate, at the expense of a higher signal-to-clutter-plus-noise ratio requirement for ambiguity identification relative to the evaluated diversity-based techniques.
2610.20928.title: Range Ambiguity Identification and Elimination by Leveraging Temporal Broadening Effect for THz Sensing

2610.20942.comment: 22 pages, 4 figures, 8 tables plus supplementary tables. To be submitted to Journal of Neural Engineering
2610.20942.summary: Objective. Studies that decode imagined speech from scalp electroencephalography (EEG) commonly validate their pipelines with a positive control, usually overt speech, and report null results without stating what effect size the pipeline could have detected. Approach. Using ds003626 ("Thinking out loud"), KaraOne and Track 3 of the 2020 International Brain-Computer Interface Competition, we audited decoding of overt speech, articulator preparation and imagined speech with artifact-channel subsets, band-limited decoding and trial selection, under a protocol that enforces split integrity by assertion. We injected class-dependent effects of known amplitude into the real recordings to measure the detection floor of five decoder families, and we checked the ds003626 labels against the dataset's acquisition protocol. Main results. On ds003626, two lip electrodes decoded overt speech at 0.7430 and the eight external channels at 0.7068, against 0.4231 for the 128-channel scalp montage, and no decodable signal survived in the 8-30 Hz band. On the other two corpora, within-subject accuracy rose monotonically with frequency into the range dominated by muscle activity. Band-power logistic regression detected an injected 8-30 Hz desynchronization of 0.54 uV under a criterion fixed in advance, whereas a compact convolutional network (EEGNet) detected nothing within subject up to 4.31 uV. In ds003626, the condition codes are the reverse of the intuitive reading, the class encoding changed between public releases, and condition is a deterministic function of time within each session. Significance. In these corpora the overt-speech positive control is dominated by myogenic signal and cannot validate a decoding pipeline. We recommend that speech-decoding studies report band-limited and artifact-channel accuracy, the direction of accuracy across frequency, and a measured detection floor.
2610.20942.title: How large an effect would we have seen? Positive controls, detection floors and dataset pitfalls in scalp-EEG speech decoding

2610.20954.comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables plus supplementary tables. To be submitted to Journal of Neural Engineering
2610.20954.summary: Objective. A decoder of imagined speech that works for a new user without calibration would make a non-invasive speech interface practical. We tested whether imagined-speech content recorded with scalp electroencephalography (EEG) transfers across people, and examined why accuracy within a single person remains low. Approach. We analyzed three public corpora, ds003626, KaraOne and Track 3 of the 2020 International Brain-Computer Interface Competition, under a protocol that enforces split integrity by assertion and reports exact binomial thresholds, group tests and bootstrap confidence intervals. We trained decoders on each participant and tested them on every other, compared representational geometry across participants without a classifier, applied subject-level alignment, and tested five explanations for the within-subject ceiling. Main results. Across 482 ordered pairs of participants, no pair survived correction for multiple comparisons; mean pair-transfer accuracy lay within 0.006 of chance on every corpus, while every within-subject reference lay above it. Imagery against pre-stimulus rest generalized at about 0.61 after artifact and elapsed-time controls, but its decoder labelled the interval preceding imagery as imagery as often as imagery itself, so the contrast reflects a post-stimulus state, not imagery. Within subject, only the competition corpus decoded above threshold for every participant (0.3147; chance 0.200); syllable count explained little of this, but its frequency profile failed an artifact audit. Significance. In these corpora, imagined-speech content did not transfer between people through any representation we examined. Trial count per class was the only variable that ordered the corpora, which favors larger single-condition datasets over further model development.
2610.20954.title: Cross-subject decoding of imagined speech from scalp EEG: a leakage-controlled evaluation on three public corpora

2610.21013.summary: Received OFDM grids preserve both pilot and payload observations, yet wireless foundation models are rarely pre-trained on them. We introduce LWM-TF, a 9.58M-parameter factorized masked autoencoder pre-trained on complex 5G NR uplink grids taken after the FFT and before channel estimation. Each block attends first across OFDM symbols and then across resource blocks and receive antennas, and the mask follows the same two axes. Because the payload phase is unpredictable, the model reconstructs the normalized log-power of each masked token and predicts its scale separately; ablations show that the two terms are complementary and that this target outperforms complex-signal reconstruction. The encoder is pre-trained on 850,496 physical uplink shared channel (PUSCH) slots from a 10^6-slot dataset simulated with the NR transmit chain under various channel conditions. With the encoder frozen, linear probes classify modulation, predict CRC success, and detect UE mobility. On a separately generated test set, 16 labeled slots per class give 0.85 modulation accuracy, 0.82 CRC area under the ROC curve (AUROC), and 0.73 mobility AUROC, ahead of a supervised CNN on every paired draw. With 10,000 labels the probes reach 0.94, 0.96, and 0.92, well above engineered receiver statistics, and detect mobility where the CNN stays at chance. Without any impairment labels, distances in the frozen feature space flag unseen waveform impairments with 0.78 macro AUROC, against 0.68 for receiver statistics. A single pre-trained encoder thus provides receiver features that transfer across tasks, most strongly when labels are scarce.
2610.21013.title: LWM-TF: A Wireless Foundation Model on 5G NR Time-Frequency Resource Grids

2610.21068.summary: In this paper, we study the spectral compressed sensing problem of recovering a spectrally sparse signal from linear compressive measurements. Exploiting the low-rank Hankel structure associated with the signal, we formulate a nonconvex fixed-rank optimization problem with a Hankel regularization. We propose a Superfast Iterative Hard Thresholding (SIHT) algorithm, where each iteration consists of a tangent-space least-squares update followed by a fixed-rank hard thresholding projection. SIHT is the first nonconvex algorithm with provable quadratic convergence for spectral compressed sensing. For random Gaussian measurements, it achieves exact recovery in the noiseless case and stable recovery in the noisy case with near-optimal sample complexity. To efficiently implement SIHT, we develop a parameterized conjugate gradient method for solving the least-squares subproblem, endowing SIHT with state-of-the-art computational and memory efficiency. Numerical experiments are provided to validate our results.
2610.21068.title: Superfast Spectral Compressed Sensing with Quadratic Convergence

2610.21187.summary: We propose a novel low-complexity soft-aided hard-decision decoding scheme for product-like codes, termed iterative bounded-distance decoding (iBDD) with graded scaled reliability and bit-flipping (GSRF). This scheme operates on four-level quantized soft information. It incorporates a graded scaled reliability rule to assign decoding confidence to the bounded-distance decoding result, and employs a bit-flipping rule based on bit-level and component-code-level reliability. A selective re-decoding rule is designed to further facilitate the error performance while keeping the number of BDD attempts in reasonably low levels. The decoding parameter design of iBDD-GSRF is investigated for product codes and staircase codes, respectively. Simulation results on both codes verify that iBDD-GSRF achieves a gain of more than 0.4 dB over the conventional iBDD, comparable to several existing unquantized soft-aided decoders.
2610.21187.title: Four-Level Quantized Soft Information Aided Hard-Decision Decoder for Product-like Codes

2610.21191.summary: Movable antennas (MAs) have recently emerged as a promising technology to enhance the wireless sensing performance by exploiting additional spatial degrees of freedom. In this work, we consider an MA-enabled near-field target localization problem under a device-based sensing architecture, where the sensing target actively transmits signals and the sensing receiver estimates its location based on the received signals. We adopt the squared position error bound (SPEB) as the sensing performance metric and aim to minimize the target's SPEB by optimizing the antenna placement at the sensing receiver. The resulting optimization problem is highly non-convex due to the minimum antenna spacing constraints and the intricate dependence of the SPEB on the antenna locations and the intractable form of SPEB. To tackle this problem, we first relax the inter-spacing constraints and accordingly formulate an antenna position distribution problem in terms of degree-4 truncated moments. The reformulated moment-based problem admits an equivalent semidefinite programming formulation and can be optimally solved using standard convex optimization solvers. Using truncated moment theory, we then recover an optimal antenna position distribution supported on a finite number of locations and construct an efficient clustered placement policy. Numerical results demonstrate that the constructed optimal distribution exhibits a three-cluster structure with source-dependent weights. The proposed antenna placement method outperforms conventional array geometries and closely approaches the exhaustive-search benchmark scheme.
2610.21191.title: Antenna Placement for Movable Antenna-Enabled Near-Field Target Localization

2610.21225.summary: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) provides a promising foundation for low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) monitoring. However, most existing studies focus primarily on position and bulk velocity, thus providing limited information about UAV rotor dynamics and orientation. To address this limitation, this paper develops an orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM)-ISAC framework that exploits UAV micro-Doppler signatures to estimate operational states, including rotor rate and rotor-axis orientation, thereby providing richer UAV state information beyond conventional ISAC localization and velocity sensing. The framework progresses from single-station micro-Doppler sensing to multi-station rotor-axis estimation. At each base station, micro-Doppler signatures are first extracted and used to estimate the rotor rate. The framework is then extended to a distributed ISAC network, where view-dependent micro-Doppler signatures from multiple sensing directions are fused to estimate the common rotor-axis direction. Since the fusion relies on Doppler-bandwidth features rather than complex channel phases, inter-station carrier-phase synchronization is not required. We show that three geometrically diverse views can locally identify both the rotor-axis direction and the unknown rotor-tip-speed scale. In addition, a feature-aware radar equation bridges blade radar cross section (RCS), sensing range, transmit power, and observation duration to micro-Doppler detection and rotor-rate estimation accuracy. The effects of residual motion and range migration on the coherent processing interval (CPI) are also analyzed. Simulations and experimental measurements validate the proposed framework and demonstrate the feasibility of rotor-rate estimation and multi-station rotor-axis sensing.
2610.21225.title: Micro-Doppler Sensing for UAV Flight-State Estimation in ISAC Networks

2610.21231.summary: We address an open problem raised by Polyanskiy and Wu in their textbook concerning the subadditivity of mutual \(f\)-information. We study two notions of generalized mutual information: mutual \(f\)-information, defined by \(\widetilde{I}_f(X;Y)=D_f(p_{XY}\|p_Xp_Y)\), and variational \((G,f)\)-information, obtained by minimizing an average of transformed \(f\)-divergences. For the first notion, we derive a sufficient condition on \(g(x)=x^2f''(x)\) that guarantees subadditivity under conditionally independent observations. This condition yields explicit families beyond the previously known examples generated by \(x\log x\) and \((x-1)\log x\). Our proof relies on the concavity of a generalized variance functional. For the variational notion, we extend existing sufficient conditions beyond the transforms \(G(x)\in\{x,\log(1+x),-\log(1-x)\}\). Using a comparison inequality for \(G^{-1}(G(A)+G(B))\), we obtain differential criteria for concave and convex transforms. Explicit constructions illustrate the resulting classes of subadditive information measures.
2610.21231.title: On the Subadditivity of Mutual f-Information

2610.21252.summary: Fluid antenna receivers can select a service position from partial port observations, but finite historical data leave uncertainty in the covariance used for that decision. We develop deployment-before-use reliability certification for a frozen partial-observation rule. A proper predictive density defines a history-based parameter region. Gaussian covariance envelopes, shared conditional-probability bounds and selector enclosures provide simultaneous risk bounds over continuous parameters and discontinuous port decisions. Separate history-coverage and integration budgets limit erroneous positive certification to 0.05 for a single qualification procedure under the stated stationary model and numerical assumptions. Confidence-set inclusion allows a new independent history to reuse the risk computation with the rule unchanged. In a structured Gaussian example with 32 candidate positions, five noisy probes and target outage 0.001, all 282 risk groups are qualified; the largest upper bound is 0.000999748. A separate coupled comparison gives a current-rule outage interval of $[7.6820,9.1266]\times10^{-4}$ and resolves lower outage than two observed-port controls using the same historical fit. One independently recalibrated history reuses the certificate without additional risk sampling. Unresolved and adverse-member controls delimit this reuse.
2610.21252.title: Finite-History Outage Certification for Partially Observed Fluid Antenna Receivers

2610.21279.comment: Accepted by IEEE Information Theory Workshop 2026
2610.21279.summary: We propose a novel soft-aided hard-decision decoding scheme for product codes based on two-bit quantized reliability markers. In particular, one bit is used for a two-level tolerance miscorrection check to validate the bounded distance decoding (BDD) result, while the other identifies bits to be randomly flipped upon BDD failure and miscorrection. List decoding is incorporated to further facilitate the error performance. Density evolution is performed for the design of the quantization thresholds. Compared to iterative BDD, the proposed scheme requires only moderate increases in memory and computational overhead. Simulation results verify that our scheme outperforms several unquantized soft-aided decoders, while maintaining small memory costs and low BDD attempts.
2610.21279.title: Iterative Bounded Distance Decoding With 2-Bit Reliability Marker For Product-Like Codes

2610.21504.summary: Cooperative multi-agent semantic communication requires deciding not only how a transmitter encodes its observation, but also which resulting semantic content should be delivered to each receiver under a limited link budget. We introduce an encoder-agnostic transmitter-side framework for receiver-specific valuation of independently selectable semantic units, termed semantic atoms. Each atom is assigned a signed value that quantifies whether delivering it is expected to improve or degrade the intended receiver's downstream decision. We formulate this effect through a controlled-delivery utility and identify it via prospective randomized payload delivery before the receiver acts. A shadow receiver estimates this utility using only transmitter-available information, from which receiver-specific leave-one-out (LOO) and Shapley atom values are computed. Experiments on a four-receiver intersection benchmark show 68.4% accuracy in recovering the sign of non-negligible LOO atom effects and a Spearman correlation of 0.302 between estimated and reference LOO values. Under limited budgets, we show that receiver-specific selection consistently outperforms shared and random alternatives, demonstrating the benefit of adapting semantic ranking to the intended receiver. At full affordability, exhaustive subset selection also outperforms full-payload transmission, showing that transmitting all available content need not maximize receiver utility. Overall, our results show that receiver-specific semantic valuation can support effective budget-constrained communication despite imperfect atom-value estimation.
2610.21504.title: Receiver-Specific Interventional Valuation of Semantic Atoms for Budget-Constrained Multi-Agent Communication

2610.21509.summary: We study structural properties of polynomial ideal (PI) codes and additive Reed--Solomon (aRS) codes in the folded Hamming metric (equivalently, the Hamming metric over a larger alphabet). We first determine the maximum possible length of PI codes, prove that the dual of every PI code is a generalized PI code, and deduce that PI codes are dually QMDS together with an explicit formula for their weight distribution. We then show that PI codes defined by irreducible polynomials correspond to aRS codes with pairwise nonconjugate evaluation points. For these aRS codes, the previous results on PI codes apply (duality, QMDS property and weight distribution).
