AI.method: 构建远场解析模型，把OAM均匀圆阵辐射、超高斯环面角向包络与零阶Bessel纵向场按三个与硬件可测参数关联的无量纲系数加权叠加；数值评估发散、SNR、链路预算与多模功率均衡，并用ANSYS HFSS全波仿真验证。
AI.motivation: OAM波束的环形强度分布随模式阶数增大而发散，在有限口径处造成功率捕获损失与各模式链路预算不均，需在波束成形层面缓解该问题。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文聚焦OAM波束的电磁结构设计与远场解析建模，未涉及CSI获取、信道估计、反馈压缩或AI方法，与研究方向关联很弱。
AI.result: 3 GHz、5λ口径下模式ℓ=1–4发散降低12–41%，ℓ≥5呈中心峰值；接收SNR增益6.4–30.9 dB；固定效率链路预算范围扩展超108%；多模功率不均衡下降最多五个数量级；中轴零点填充至峰值8–100%；模式间无混叠，目标模式功率占比>0.54；z=500λ处OAM-MDM容量提升最多107%。
AI.tldr: 提出环面-OAM混合波束：将同轴喇叭产生的环面电磁脉冲（角向约束强、纵场强）与常规OAM波束加权叠加，以远场模型降低OAM发散并填补中轴零点，3 GHz/5λ口径下将模式1–4发散减小12–41%，链路SNR增益6.4–30.9 dB，OAM-MDM容量最高提升2.1倍。

item.summary: Orbital angular momentum (OAM) beams offer spatially independent multiplexing in wireless communications, but their donut-shaped intensity diverges with mode order, causing power capture loss at finite apertures and unequal link budgets. We propose a toroidal-OAM hybrid beam that combines the angular confinement and strong longitudinal electric field of toroidal electromagnetic pulses from a coaxial horn with a conventional OAM beam, lowering angular spread and producing non-zero on-axis intensity. A far-field model is built as a weighted superposition of OAM uniform circular array (UCA) radiation, a super-Gaussian toroidal angular envelope, and a zeroth-order Bessel longitudinal field, controlled by three dimensionless parameters (toroidal confinement, coupling strength, longitudinal coefficient) tied to measurable hardware. Numerical results at 3 GHz with a $5\lambda$ aperture show 12--41% divergence reduction for OAM modes $\ell = 1$--$4$, while modes $\ell \geq 5$ become fully center-peaked. The suppression ratio stays unchanged for fixed $kR$, $\kappa$, $\alpha$, $\beta$, and $\ell$. Link evaluation shows 6.4--30.9 dB received SNR gain, over 108% extension in fixed-efficiency link-budget range, and up to five orders of magnitude reduction in multi-mode power imbalance. The central null is filled to 8--100% of the peak; the hybrid beam does not mix OAM modes, with intended-mode power fraction above $0.54$ where the ring is well-defined. OAM mode-division multiplexing capacity at $z=500\lambda$ shows up to $2.1\times$ ($107\%$) capacity enhancement. Full-wave simulation in ANSYS HFSS corroborates the model, confirming the hybrid launcher preserves the OAM vortex phase while reducing divergence compared with a UCA-only baseline. These findings establish toroidal beam engineering as a practical tool for OAM-based wireless links.
item.title: Toroidal-OAM Hybrid Beam for Divergence-Suppressed OAM Wireless Communication

AI.conclusion: 建立统一基准是缓解"科学债务"、在AI方法与人工算法共存时代厘清研究格局的关键，Sionna Bench作为起点有望推动无线通信研究的基准化。
AI.method: 构建Sionna Bench基准平台，以AI辅助编码将既有方法（来自不同论文）在统一框架下实现；试点选取MIMO-OFDM信道估计问题，实现对20种方法（源自10篇论文）的统一复现与对比。
AI.motivation: 无线通信学术界缺乏基准，同一问题的方法常在略有差异的设置下各自开发，缺少统一比较框架，形成"科学债务"；智能体AI与AI辅助编码使大规模复现并统一化实现成为可能。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文核心为MIMO-OFDM信道估计方法的大规模统一实现与基准比较，直接对应研究者的信道估计与可复现/跨设置泛化评测需求，但AI成分仅为辅助复现工具而非新方法。
relevance_topics: 信道估计基准与可复现评测
AI.result: 首个信道估计基准已集成20种来自10篇论文的方法，可在统一设置下与最先进方法进行可比对照。
AI.tldr: 提出Sionna Bench，用智能体AI辅助编码在大规模统一框架下重现并比较学术界的无线通信方法，首个试点为MIMO-OFDM信道估计基准，收录来自10篇论文的20种方法。

item.summary: Academic research in wireless communications has no tradition of benchmarks so far. Remarkable progress in benchmark-oriented fields like machine learning suggests that the adoption of benchmarks could benefit our field. In the absence of benchmarks, however, a scientific debt has accumulated: since the academic community has not canonized specific problem setups, methods that address essentially the same problem were often developed for slightly different setups and lack a common framework for comparison. Any attempt to establish a new benchmark is faced with the challenge of resolving this debt. Recent advances in agentic artificial intelligence (AI) create an opportunity to do so by leveraging AI-assisted coding. This makes it possible to implement the state-of-the art at scale and to adapt it to a common framework for comparison. We present Sionna Bench to initiate benchmarks in academic wireless communications research. As a pilot study, we use the problem of MIMO-OFDM channel estimation. At the time of writing, Sionna Bench's channel estimation benchmark features twenty channel estimation methods that were implemented from ten different papers. The ability to compare methods against the state-of-the-art will be crucial for navigating the research landscape in an era where AI-generated methods coexist with human-developed algorithms.
item.title: Sionna Bench: Towards Benchmarks in Wireless Communications

AI.conclusion: 通过子集激活与端口选择的联合设计可在保持全激活中断概率的同时降低激活数量，并在满足显式开销条件时提升净能效。
AI.method: 将全激活的divide-and-sort几何推广到子集选择的精确角度事件扫描；推导确定性增益上下界与激活单调性；对独立RIS支路、相关接收端口给出单单元中断精确表达式及高SNR渐近；证明固定正定RIS协方差下的分集阶数；在完美CSI下设计QoS约束的最小激活策略并给出开销判据。
AI.motivation: 为提升RIS辅助系统中能效与中断性能，需在流体天线端口与RIS单元子集激活（而非全激活）之间做联合设计，并刻画相关信道下的增益与开销权衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 涉及RIS辅助无线系统与信道统计/中断分析，但以信号处理与性能理论推导为主，缺乏AI方法且不涉及CSI获取、反馈压缩或信道重建。
AI.result: 相关信道数值基准显示子集选择带来增益、孔径效应以及依赖开销的能效折衷；高SNR下分集阶数等于激活RIS单元数。
AI.tldr: 该文联合优化流体天线端口选择、固定基数RIS单元激活与1-bit反射相位，用精确角度事件扫描把全激活的divide-and-sort几何扩展到子集选择，并给出确定性增益界、激活单调性、单单元中断精确式与高SNR渐近、以及分集阶数等于RIS单元数的证明；在完美瞬时CSI下提出QoS感知的最小激活策略与开销条件。

item.summary: This letter jointly optimizes fluid-antenna port selection, fixed-cardinality reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) element activation, and 1-bit reflection phases through an exact angular event sweep that extends full-activation divide-and-sort geometry to subset selection. We establish deterministic gain bounds and activation monotonicity, derive exact single-element outage expressions and high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) asymptotics for independent RIS branches with correlated receiving ports, and prove diversity order equal to the RIS element count for fixed positive-definite RIS covariance. With perfect instantaneous channel state information, a quality-of-service aware policy activates the minimum number of elements required to meet a target SNR while preserving full-activation outage probability. An explicit overhead condition identifies when reduced activation improves net energy efficiency. Correlated-channel benchmarks illustrate subset-selection gains, aperture effects, and overhead-dependent energy-efficiency tradeoffs.
item.title: QoS-Aware Joint 1-Bit RIS Element Activation and Fluid-Antenna Port Selection

AI.conclusion: 变分正则化方向与权重的选择对半盲极化信道估计有实质影响，而全盲设置下弱 KL 正则化未带来可分辨的改善。
AI.method: 采用基于 VAE 的概率物理参数估计器 VISTA：半盲分支将信道相关统计量映射到 2x2 复极化信道；对比前向 KL、反向 KL、Average Jeffreys、Max-KL 与自适应 Jeffreys 正则，分析 KL 方向不对称性与正则权重 ζ 的影响；另设仅用接收数据的全盲 QPSK 接收机（直接均衡器优化、Adam）。
AI.motivation: 双极化自由空间量子链路存在极化混扰、衰落、相位漂移与信道监督稀缺问题，需要有效的盲/半盲接收端均衡方法。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽涉及 VAE 变分估计与盲均衡，但应用场景为自由空间量子通信极化链路，与陆地无线 CSI 获取/反馈/重建方向关联很弱。
AI.result: 500 次配对蒙特卡洛中，前向 KL 对 ζ 几乎不敏感，反向/对称目标呈先优后劣；ζ=3e-5 时 Average Jeffreys 使信道 NRMSE 中位数较前向 KL 降低约 4.8%；KL 不对称性减小并不必然降低信道误差。3000 次配对试验下各 VISTA 变体中位块 NMSE 几乎相同，均值 NMSE 相对 CMA+分离基线的改善集中在困难大误差样本，直接 W 优化（Adam）可复现大部分均值改善；全盲场景弱正则化无明显增益。
AI.tldr: 论文研究双极化自由空间量子通信链路的变分盲/半盲均衡，基于变分自编码器的物理参数估计器 VISTA，比较多种 KL 正则化方向（前向/反向/对称 Jeffreys 等）对 2x2 复极化信道估计误差的影响。

item.summary: Dual-polarization free-space quantum communication links require receiver equalization under polarization mixing, fading, phase variation, and limited channel supervision. This paper investigates variational blind and semi-blind equalization using VISTA (Variational Inference for Signal Tracking and Adaptation), a variational autoencoder-based probabilistic physical parameter estimator. In the semi-blind branch, channel-relevant statistics are mapped to the underlying 2x2 complex polarization channel. We compare forward KL, reverse KL, Average Jeffreys, Max-KL, and Adaptive Jeffreys regularization and analyze directional KL asymmetry and the local effect of the regularization weight zeta. Over 500 paired Monte Carlo trials, forward KL is nearly insensitive to zeta, whereas reverse and symmetric objectives exhibit low-error regions followed by degradation under stronger regularization. At zeta = 3 x 10^-5, Average Jeffreys reduces median channel NRMSE by approximately 4.8% relative to forward KL at the same weight. Reduced KL asymmetry does not necessarily imply lower channel error. A separate fully blind QPSK receiver estimates a direct equalizer from received data only. Over 3000 paired trials, the VISTA variants have nearly identical median aligned block-NMSE, while their lower mean aligned block-NMSE relative to the CMA-plus-separation baseline is concentrated in difficult, large-error trials. Direct-W optimization with Adam reproduces most of this mean reduction. In the fully blind benchmark, the tested weak regularizers provide no resolved improvement over unregularized VISTA.
item.title: Variational Blind Equalization for Dual-Polarization Free-Space Quantum Communications

AI.conclusion: 四元数表示与鲁棒加权对非高斯污染下的接收处理有一定收益，但增益主要源于有界激活而非四元数结构；所提方法仅在接收机处理层面评估，不构成可组合的CV-QKD安全性证明。
AI.method: 将四路极化与正交分量编码为四元数样本，建立可辨识的有效信道模型；提出四元数值投影统计量QVPS及自适应版本AQVPS（在样本级投影离群度上加入局部二阶描述子）；采用径向Huber加权实现鲁棒复值/四元数信道估计；并以神经实验对比实值、复值、四元数与广义线性复值接收机，辅以激活函数匹配实验与消融分析。
AI.motivation: 双极化自由空间量子链路产生两路耦合复外差流，在衰落、极化混合、校准失配和脉冲污染等非高斯扰动下，常规复值接收机信道估计与检测性能下降，需要更鲁棒的表示与估计方法。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文涉及鲁棒信道估计与四元数/复值神经网络表示，但应用场景为自由空间量子通信外差接收，未涉及RF CSI采集、反馈压缩或无线传播建模。
relevance_topics: 非高斯干扰下的鲁棒接收
AI.result: 鲁棒估计降低了对非高斯污染的敏感性；局部二阶描述子相比QVPS提升了局部化扰动检测能力，但仅用描述子的消融略优于完整AQVPS；干净高斯SNR扫描中复值LMMSE的评估MSE最低，而在污染扫描中四元数神经网络平均MSE最低；激活匹配实验表明其鲁棒性很大程度来自有界激活函数而非四元数参数化本身。
AI.tldr: 论文提出基于四元数的鲁棒接收机方法，用于双极化自由空间量子通信中两路耦合复外差流的信道估计与干扰诊断，并比较实值、复值、四元数及广义线性复值神经接收机在非高斯污染下的表现。

item.summary: Dual-polarization free-space quantum communication receivers produce two coupled complex heterodyne streams. We develop robust quaternion receiver methods for such links under fading, polarization mixing, calibration mismatch, impulsive contamination, and other non-Gaussian disturbances. The four polarization and quadrature components are encoded as quaternion-valued samples. We formulate an identifiable effective channel model, Quaternion-Valued Projection Statistics (QVPS), and Adaptive QVPS (AQVPS), which augments samplewise projection outlyingness with robust local second-order descriptors. Robust complex and quaternion channel estimators use radial Huber weighting, while QVPS and AQVPS are evaluated separately as disturbance diagnostics. Neural experiments compare matched real-, complex-, quaternion-, and widely linear complex-valued receivers. Robust estimation reduces sensitivity to non-Gaussian contamination. Local second-order descriptors improve detection of the tested localized disturbances relative to QVPS, and a descriptor-only ablation slightly outperforms full AQVPS. Complex LMMSE gives the lowest evaluation MSE in the clean Gaussian SNR sweep, whereas the Quaternion NN, among the compared receivers with their nominal activations, gives the lowest mean evaluation MSE in the tested contaminated sweeps. Activation-matched experiments indicate that much of the nominal Quaternion NN robustness is attributable to bounded activation rather than quaternion parameterization alone. The methods are evaluated at the receiver processing level and do not constitute a composable CV-QKD security proof.
item.title: Quaternion-Valued Adaptive Projection Statistics for Neural Receivers in Dual-Polarization Free-Space Quantum Communications

AI.conclusion: 结构化张量代数分解可在FIM配置多样性与低复杂度之间取得平衡，为可重构/形变超表面场景下的信道获取提供实用方案。
AI.method: 构建跨校准FIM配置的结构化PARAFAC模型；利用已知identity因子与秩一pilot-weighted信道因子，采用逐阵元秩一近似、参考状态归一化、全局秩一投影及最小二乘morphing因子更新的确定性非迭代代数分解；再将空间因子与形变因子联合匹配校准流形以估计公共角度、用户增益及配置相关信道。

item.summary: Flexible intelligent metasurfaces (FIMs) create geometric diversity through aperture morphing, but their configuration-dependent responses complicate uplink channel estimation. This letter considers multiple users sharing a common angular response and develops a structured PARAFAC model across calibrated FIM configurations. Its known identity factor and rank-one pilot-weighted channel factor enable deterministic, noniterative algebraic factor recovery through per-element rank-one approximations, reference-state normalization, global rank-one projection, and a least-squares morphing-factor update. The recovered spatial and morphing factors are then jointly matched to the calibrated manifold to estimate the common angles, user gains, and configuration-dependent channels. Simulations demonstrate accurate recovery and show that out-of-plane morphing resolves the azimuth-sign ambiguity of an undeformed planar aperture; an angular-spread experiment quantifies the mismatch when the common-response assumption is relaxed.
item.title: Structured PARAFAC Channel Estimation for Flexible Intelligent Metasurface Receivers

item.summary: Reconstructing a radio map (RM) from sparse received-power measurements supports non-cooperative interference monitoring and spectrum management. However,sparse measurements leave uncertainty about both the global RM and the interfering emitter location, making informative sampling and accurate reconstruction challenging. To address these challenges, a novel joint sampling and reconstruction method named RMSampler is proposed in this paper to improve measurement selection and RM reconstruction under limited measurement budgets. For measurement selection, RMSampler evaluates global RM error reduction using the covariance of diffusion-generated RMs and localization error reduction using candidate emitter locations. Because these errors have different units, their expected relative reductions are combined into a scale-invariant sampling criterion, with each acquired measurement updating both uncertainty estimates. After sampling, the updated emitter-location probabilities guide a separate conditional diffusion ensemble for final reconstruction. To improve measurement agreement, an effective sample size (ESS) target guides robust posterior correction, followed by a minimum-distortion projection enforcing measurement and building constraints. For the reconstruction ensemble, analysis establishes that increasing likelihood power reduces expected robust measurement loss, while pretrained neural parameters and architecture remain unchanged. Experiments using simulated and real-world measured data demonstrate improved reconstruction under matched measurement budgets. In the Chongqing real-world measured data experiment, root mean square error (RMSE) decreases from 3.54 to 2.73~dB relative to random sampling under a common reconstruction method.
item.title: RMSampler: Sparse Radio Map Reconstruction with Active Sampling and Diffusion Posterior Correction

AI.conclusion: 单比特反馈驱动的AID前缀游走可在无信道估计下实现低复杂度、可解析的AoI-吞吐权衡，其性能接近理想信道知识上界，为有限反馈下的链路自适应提供了理论支撑。

item.summary: We study adaptive prefix-length selection for reliability-ordered coded transmission over $N$ coordinates, using only the $K$ most reliable, to balance age of information (AoI) against throughput. An additive-increase/decrease (AID) prefix-walk controller updates the prefix length from the last decoding outcome alone, at $O(1)$ per-slot cost with no channel estimation, inducing an irreducible birth--death chain whose mean drift fixes a unique balance point $K^\dagger$ (largest $K$ with success probability $\ge\tfrac12$), around which the stationary distribution concentrates geometrically. We derive this distribution in closed form via detailed balance and obtain exact steady-state AoI and goodput via renewal-reward analysis. Simulations on a $64$-coordinate polar code over a binary symmetric channel (BSC) confirm these predictions to within $0.3\%$. Relative to a genie-aided upper bound with perfect channel knowledge, we further quantify the goodput cost of adapting from a single feedback bit alone.
item.title: AoI-Aware Polar Code Blind Rate Adaptation

item.summary: Multi-threshold (MT) sampling records threshold-crossing times for parameter estimation in applications including positron emission tomography, oil well logging, and photon-counting X-ray imaging. We study whether the distribution of recorded crossings uniquely determines the signal parameters and how many thresholds are required for this identifiability. For a fixed MT sampler, we show that the ranks of distribution derivatives with respect to the parameters cannot increase through crossing, timing, and selection. Under suitable regularity assumptions, we characterize local identifiability by a full-rank Jacobian of finitely many event probabilities defined on recorded crossings and establish a necessary and sufficient global identifiability criterion under additional rank and topological assumptions. For a nonhomogeneous Poisson signal model with four intensity parameters, a fixed known single-photon response, and deterministic MT sampling, we prove that four cumulative probabilities of the first recorded crossing time establish local and global identifiability under their respective conditions using a single sufficiently small positive threshold. This attains the minimum number of thresholds for the specified model and sampler. Numerical experiments illustrate these results and reveal weak parameter sensitivity and substantial finite-sample estimation errors when estimation uses these probabilities. The results establish parameter uniqueness while highlighting the role of statistical sensitivity in accurate estimation.
item.title: Multi-Threshold Sampling: Local and Global Parameter Identifiability

item.summary: Reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RISs) have emerged as one of the most promising technologies for the next-generation wireless networks, offering advantages such as cost efficiency, low power consumption, flexible deployment, and large effective aperture. Extensive studies have demonstrated the capabilities of RISs to enhance communication performance, including coverage extension, sum-rate improvement, interference suppression, security enhancement, etc. As 6G networks continue to evolve, wireless sensing is expected to play a pivotal role alongside communication. Undoubtedly, RISs possess great potential to enable seamless integration of sensing and communication by supporting both passive and active sensing paradigms. This paper explores how RISs can revolutionize wireless networks by enhancing both communication and sensing capabilities. Specifically, we highlight the fundamental principles, potential applications, and future trends of RIS-assisted integrated sensing and communication (ISAC), anticipating that RIS-enabled ISAC will become a key enabler in the upcoming 6G era.
item.title: Revolutionizing 6G Wireless Networks with RISs: Enhancements in Sensing and Communications

item.summary: We develop information--estimation relations for an arbitrary discrete memoryless channel with finite input and output alphabets by varying the expected number of observations while keeping the channel fixed. A single hidden input is observed through a Poisson number of conditionally independent channel uses, whose mean specifies the observation budget. The derivative of mutual information with respect to this budget equals the minimum expected relative-entropy loss for estimating the input's output distribution. The posterior average of the channel's output distributions achieves this minimum and is the Bayesian predictor for the next observation. When the input distribution, the channel, or both are misspecified, the relative entropy between the true and assumed observation laws is the integral of the excess prediction loss over the budget. We also extend these relations to finite-state processes taking values in the input alphabet and observed through the channel at independent Poisson sampling times. Both in the matched setting and under model mismatch, the expected prediction loss accumulated over time using past observations equals the corresponding loss using the full observation record (noncausal estimation), averaged over lower sampling rates.
item.title: Information, Estimation, and Prediction for Discrete Memoryless Channels via Poissonization

item.comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Information Theory
item.summary: Soft information perturbations can significantly improve the successive cancellation (SC) decoding performance of polar codes. This is an effective method for realizing low-latency yet high performance for long polar codes, since each perturbation-based SC (PSC) decoding can be performed in parallel. However, little theoretical insight has been revealed so far regarding its work rationale. This paper provides the theoretical analysis of the soft information perturbation. It reveals that PSC decoding improves the SC decoding performance through correcting the erroneous bit estimations, especially the first erroneous bit (FEB). It further validates that perturbing the soft information does not degrade the error-correction capability of SC decoding. Such revelations lead to the design of optimal perturbations that maximizes the FEB correction probability, resulting in an enhanced PSC decoding performance. Based on this, a novel hybrid PSC (HPSC) decoding is proposed. By introducing the random and biased perturbations, the HPSC decoding can better divert from the initial erroneous estimation and converge to the intended one. Our simulation results demonstrate that with the optimal perturbation, the HPSC decoding can achieve a similar performance as the cyclic redundancy check (CRC) aided SC list (CA-SCL) decoding, while avoiding path sorting and expansion.
item.title: Efficient Perturbation-Based SC Decoding for Long Polar Codes

item.summary: Maximum-likelihood (ML) decoding of linear block codes is NP-hard, so neural decoders are evaluated by how closely they approach it. We observe that proving a candidate optimal can be far easier than finding it, and build a decoder that does both. We cast decoding as a search over an absorbing-state discrete diffusion model, whose sequential commitment of coordinates turns generation into a tree, and run a probability beam search over it. A dual bound from a linear-programming relaxation and a distance-based test, both derived from the code, then certify per frame that the current candidate is the global ML solution; because both are theorems, certified frames incur no accuracy-computation trade-off. Across $15$ codes and five operating points we certify up to $99.9\%$ of frames, the two tests dividing the space as their derivations predict, one strong for sparse parity-check matrices and the other for codes with a large minimum distance. Certification also behaves as a per-frame reliability signal, with $96.7$-$100\%$ of all frame errors falling on uncertified frames. Against an exact ML reference at $5$ dB the decoder is within one standard deviation on three of the four codes where the reference is uncensored, and against four neural baselines it attains the best bit-error rate in $71$ of $75$ cells.
item.title: Certified Adaptive List Decoding for Error-Correcting Codes

item.summary: Multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) is a key technology in modern wireless networks, but its performance is often analyzed under ideal hardware assumptions. In practical implementations, however, quantization appears throughout the signal-processing chain, including channel state information (CSI) feedback, fronthaul signaling, beamforming coefficients, data converters, and finite-resolution phase shifters. These impairments do not act independently: they alter the channel information available for beamforming, constrain the feasible transmit signals, and can ultimately limit beamforming gain and interference suppression. This article provides a perspective on quantized beamforming by connecting its main sources, performance implications, and mitigation strategies. We discuss codebook-based CSI feedback, quantization-aware beamforming, low-resolution converter modeling, and finite-resolution hybrid beamforming, and use representative numerical examples to illustrate when quantization becomes a dominant performance bottleneck. We further highlight emerging directions in joint beamforming and quantization design, adaptive-resolution architectures, and new antenna technologies with discrete hardware constraints. The key message is that finite-resolution effects should be modeled explicitly and incorporated into the beamforming design rather than treated as an afterthought.
item.title: When Every Bit Counts in Quantized Beamforming: From CSI Feedback to Low-Resolution Hardware

item.summary: Information theory has become a standard tool across the natural and social sciences, yet practical use is limited by estimator choice, fragmented software, reproducibility, and computational cost. We present infomeasure-rs, an open-source Rust library that brings a broad set of information-theoretic measures and estimators into one self-contained, type-safe package. It covers entropy, mutual information, conditional mutual information, transfer entropy, conditional transfer entropy, cross-entropy, and the Kullback-Leibler and Jensen-Shannon divergences, with discrete (plug-in and bias-corrected), kernel, ordinal, and nearest-neighbour estimators, including the Rényi and Tsallis families, and exposes local and global values and significance testing through a consistent trait interface. It ships as a single portable binary with no runtime dependency and is continuously validated against a reference implementation. On a single central processing unit (CPU) core, and even without its GPU or parallel paths, it is the fastest of the packages we compared across languages, matching the closest packages only for plug-in discrete entropy and substantially faster for mutual information, the conditional and transfer measures, and the kernel, ordinal, and generalised-entropy estimators. The optional GPU and multi-threaded paths accelerate selected continuous estimators further. The library is open source and, to our knowledge, the most complete information-theory package for Rust.
item.title: infomeasure-rs: A High-Performance Rust Library for Information-Theoretic Measures and Estimators

item.summary: This paper studies reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) configuration for a single-input single-output (SISO) communication link using a two-stage estimate-then-optimize procedure. Within this framework, two common approaches to the estimation stage are pilot-based channel estimation and received signal strength (RSS)-based channel estimation. Our hardware experiments reveal substantial inter-block phase evolution consistent with residual CFO, while simulations show that such phase rotations can severely degrade pilot-based channel estimation when left uncompensated. In contrast, RSS-based approaches are less affected by these phase rotations, although they often require a large number of measurements to achieve a near-optimal received signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). To address this measurement requirement, we propose parametric physics-guided neural blind beamforming (\textsc{P-PGNBB}) for RSS-based channel estimation. Simulations and hardware experiments confirm that the proposed method achieves a received SNR close to that obtained with perfect channel state information (CSI) and comparable to existing methods, while requiring substantially fewer RSS measurements.
item.title: RIS Configuration with Low-Overhead Measurements via Physics-Guided Neural Networks

item.summary: Two-dimensional (2D) convolutional codes are a generalization of one-dimensional (1D) convolutional codes and are naturally suitable for encoding two-dimensional data. Although their theoretical properties are well established, practical applications are limited due to the lack of error-correction decoding algorithms. While the Viterbi algorithm provides an efficient decoding method for 1D convolutional codes, no analogous approach exists for the 2D case. In this paper, we introduce a decoding algorithm for 2D convolutional codes, called the 2D Viterbi algorithm, extending the principles of the classical Viterbi algorithm to the two-dimensional setting. The presented 2D Viterbi algorithm works with linear systems representations of 2D convolutional codes and its complexity depends on the dimension of the corresponding 2D linear system. Hence, we also provide several algorithms to obtain 2D realizations of small dimension.
item.title: Error-correction Decoding for 2D Convolutional Codes with a Generalized Viterbi Algorithm

item.summary: The measured logical error rate of a quantum low-density parity-check (QLDPC) code depends on the decoding algorithm. We develop a framework that certifies non-degenerate maximum-likelihood (ML) decoding outcomes on individual sampled shots under circuit-level noise, providing a common reference for comparing decoders and codes. Upper and lower bounds on the minimum correction cost in the true and competing logical classes establish success, failure, or an undecided outcome. Branch-and-bound search refines these intervals while retaining valid bounds under resource limits. Counting the outcomes bounds the empirical ML logical error rate, with interval width equal to the undecided fraction. Results for two bivariate bicycle codes show that best-first ordered statistics decoding (BF-OSD) tracks the non-degenerate ML benchmark closely while leaving some ML-correctable shots.
item.title: Certified Non-Degenerate Maximum-Likelihood Benchmarking of Quantum LDPC Decoders

item.summary: We prove the MDS length bound for nontrivial irreducible cyclic codes of every composite length. The classical trace realization turns the MDS property into independence of elements of a multiplicative subgroup. Every nonidentity subgroup must have the full extension degree. This restriction yields length congruences, and the Frobenius-orbit description of the coefficient field gives an exact descent obstruction. A cyclotomic argument reduces each fixed dimension to finitely many parameters. For dimensions at most thirty, established geometric bounds reduce the alphabet to a small finite range; the remaining twelve parameter triples are excluded by explicit products of at most three determinant factors and a low-degree multiplier argument. An independent argument proves the composite-length theorem in arbitrary dimension. The standardness conclusion is stated separately as a conditional consequence of the classification statement of Feng, Hollmann, Li, and Xiang; the correct extension-field reduction retains a semilinear quotient. The general prime-length problem is not settled here. Neither length proof uses the automorphism classification or the recent odd-characteristic range announced by Fan.
item.title: Length Bounds for Irreducible Cyclic MDS Codes

item.summary: Reliable microstructural parameter estimation in diffusion MRI (dMRI) critically depends on the acquisition protocol. Yet, common protocol design criteria may not fully reflect estimator bias, parameter constraints, and nonlinear fitting behavior in complex inverse problems. Here, we introduce Protocol Optimization via Loss Assessing Parameter Recovery (POLAR), an end-to-end framework that searches the continuous acquisition space and directly minimizes multiparameter recovery error through noisy signal simulation and the chosen model fitting. We demonstrate POLAR spanning distinct microstructural environments: the Cylinder-Zeppelin model for white matter, Neurite Exchange Imaging (NEXI) for gray matter, and Cellular Exchange Imaging (CEXI) for permeable cells. Across independent held-out parameter sets, POLAR consistently outperformed model-specific reference designs, reducing RMSE by up to $50\%$ for Cylinder-Zeppelin and $74\%$ for CEXI, while reducing NEXI exchange time bias by $70\%$. These gains across distinct biophysical models, acquisition settings, and reference design strategies demonstrate the benefit of optimizing acquisition protocols through the downstream parameter-estimation problem. POLAR provides a flexible, model-specific and estimator-aware framework for designing dMRI protocols tailored to the microstructural parameters and experimental conditions of interest.
item.title: Diffusion MRI protocol design for reliable parameter recovery: a unified framework across biophysical models

item.summary: Pointing error is critical in highly directional communication systems, where even slight misalignment leads to severe received power reduction. Existing pointing error models fail to cover diverse practical scenarios due to restrictive distributional and design limitations. This paper proposes a novel pointing error model incorporating jitters, AoD/AoA estimation errors, and comprehensive design impacts, including phase shifter quantization, antenna patterns, array design, beamforming architectures, steering capabilities, and bandwidth. To accomplish this, antenna patterns are modeled for both high- and low-gain configurations. Then, the array factor's main lobe is approximated as a Gaussian beam for subarrays and superarrays, accommodating analog and digital beamforming stages in wideband systems under beam squint presence or compensation. Jitters and estimation errors are incorporated via 3D rotations, while phase shift quantization is captured through the phase excitations of the arrays. It is shown that the resulting pointing error follows a novel distribution: the negative log-shifted Gamma (NLSG). Fully characterized by only shape, scale, and location parameters, the NLSG features closed-form statistical expressions. This formulation ensures tractable mathematical manipulation, making it a practical, scalable tool for system design and analysis. Validation via normalized moment error, Jensen-Shannon divergence, and Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistics confirms exceptional accuracy, yielding values primarily below 1%, 0.02, and 0.05, respectively. Furthermore, capacity analysis has demonstrated that specific design choices are paramount for achieving optimal capacity. Finally, important guidelines for designing highly directional wideband communication systems are provided to mitigate the detrimental effects of pointing errors, thereby paving the way for robust next-generation networks.
item.title: Negative Log-Shifted Gamma: A Generalized Pointing Error Model for Directional Wideband Systems

item.summary: We develop an information-theoretic method for lower bounding the prior-predictive conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) of loss in interactive statistical decision making (ISDM). A generalized Fano inequality replaces a single error event by a randomized binary statistic constructed from a bounded transform of the loss, reducing the problem to a Bernoulli $f$-divergence inequality. A bounded hinge transform yields a direct lower bound on Bayesian CVaR under a prior fixed in advance. We derive reverse-KL specializations and obtain explicit bounds for Gaussian mean estimation and Gaussian stochastic bandits. We then impose local differential privacy (LDP) at the observation stage of the same ISDM model. LDP contraction inequalities combined with the adaptive KL chain rule give explicit Bayesian CVaR lower bounds for Gaussian mean estimation with heterogeneous privacy parameters and Gaussian $K$-armed bandits.
item.title: Lower bounds for Bayesian CVaR in interactive problems with local differential privacy

Each beam agent aggregates information from interference neighbors via graph convolution before estimating local Q-values, which are then decomposed by the standard mixing network. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves 34.4\% higher throughput than QMIX with more stable interference management, under non-uniform traffic and co-channel interference settings.
item.title: Interference-Graph-Aided Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Beam Hopping LEO Satellite Networks

item.summary: Federated learning based radio map estimation (RME) approaches rely on frequent exchange of high-dimensional model updates and often require a central server for collaboration coordination and update aggregation. This incurs prohibitively high communication overhead, rendering them impractical for bandwidth-constrained mobile and wireless edge networks. Moreover, in practical mobile sensing scenarios, sparse and unevenly collected measurements lead to estimation uncertainty, which is critical for guiding RME and collaboration among distributed nodes. To address these challenges, this paper proposes an uncertainty-aware distributed radio map estimation (UA-D-RME) framework for decentralized networks. In UA-D-RME, each node locally infers a probabilistic model from its sparse measurements to estimate both its local radio map and the associated estimation uncertainty. Instead of exchanging raw data or model updates, neighboring nodes communicate only low-dimensional statistical information, including radio map and uncertainty measures over their overlapping monitoring areas. An uncertainty-aware statistical consensus mechanism is then developed to iteratively align probabilistic models in neighborhood by ensuring consistency on estimation confidence. Theoretical analysis establishes the convergence of the proposed consensus mechanism and characterizes the distributed generalization performance of the proposed UA-D-RME method. Experiments on urban radio map datasets verify that UA-D-RME achieves desired reconstruction accuracy comparable to the centralized RME benchmark while reducing communication costs and without exchanging raw measurements.
item.title: Uncertainty-Aware Distributed Radio Map Estimation in Decentralized Wireless Networks

item.summary: The $\mathbb{Z}_p\mathbb{Z}_{p^2}$-additive codes are subgroups of $\mathbb{Z}_p^{\alpha_1}\times\mathbb{Z}_{p^2}^{\alpha_2}$, and they can be seen as linear codes over $\mathbb{Z}_p$ when $\alpha_2=0$, as $\mathbb{Z}_{p^2}$-additive codes when $\alpha_1=0$, and as $\mathbb{Z}_2\mathbb{Z}_4$-additive codes when $p=2$. A $\mathbb{Z}_p\mathbb{Z}_{p^2}$-linear generalized Hadamard (GH) code is a GH code over $\mathbb{Z}_p$ which is the Gray map image of a $\mathbb{Z}_p\mathbb{Z}_{p^2}$-additive code. For every prime $p$, there are recursive constructions of $\mathbb{Z}_p\mathbb{Z}_{p^2}$-linear GH codes $H_p^{t_1,t_2}$ with $\alpha_1\neq0$ and $\alpha_2\neq0$, and of $\mathbb{Z}_{p^s}$-linear GH codes $\bar H_p^{t_1,\dots,t_s}$. We show that the kernel blocks of a nonlinear code $H_p^{t_1,t_2}$ give equivalent punctured codes, and that these punctured codes are linear. Any of them is called the derived code of $H_p^{t_1,t_2}$. We also determine the ranks of the codes $H_p^{t_1,t_2}$ and $\bar H_p^{t_1,t_2}$. For odd $p$, the rank of $H_p^{t_1,t_2}$ depends on the Bernoulli numbers modulo $p$. By comparing the derived codes and the ranks, we show that, for odd $p$, no code $H_p^{t_1,t_2}$ is equivalent to any of these $\mathbb{Z}_{p^s}$-linear GH codes. For $p=2$, a nonlinear code $H_2^{t_1,t_2}$ is equivalent to a $\mathbb{Z}_{2^s}$-linear Hadamard code if and only if $t_2\geq2$. Finally, we count the nonequivalent codes in the union of both families.
item.title: Nonequivalence of $\mathbb{Z}_p\mathbb{Z}_{p^2}$-linear and $\mathbb{Z}_{p^s}$-linear generalized Hadamard codes for odd primes

item.summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) platforms with integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) are prime candidates for surveillance missions, in which a dual-function drone tracks a mobile target and alerts a ground station when the target enters a protected region. Such alerts generate event-triggered communication traffic. By observing the change in the traffic, an eavesdropper (Eve) can therefore learn in real time whether the target is detected inside the protected region without decoding any message. Existing physical-layer security techniques protect the message content or hide that a transmission occurs, but the composition of the traffic remains exposed. We formulate the threat as traffic-composition covertness and propose a keyless diffusion-based transmission scheme that hides the triggered traffic. The scheme superposes the beamformed information streams of the UAV with a message-agnostic safeguard waveform generated by a conditional denoising diffusion implicit model. Training shapes the safeguard distribution such that triggered and non-triggered slots become statistically indistinguishable at Eve. The legitimate user shares no secret key with the UAV. We formulate the joint design as a rate maximization under covertness, reliability, and sensing constraints, with the sensing accuracy measured by the posterior Cramér-Rao bound (PCRB) of the beam-dependent tracking problem. Our numerical results show that, with multiple transmit antennas and an Eve signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of $5$~dB, a learned Eve stays near the blind guess of $0.5$ for every safeguard beam split, a detector that knows the safeguard model reaches $0.71$ to $0.73$ inside Bob's main lobe and $0.53$ to $0.55$ outside it, while the average position PCRB varies only between $0.59$ and $0.70$~m$^2$.
item.title: Generative Diffusion Models for Secure UAV-ISAC with Real-Time Target Tracking

item.summary: Generating graph signals is an important task in machine learning, and incorporating the underlying graph into a generative model enables structurally-informed distribution modeling. However, said graph is often noisy or imperfectly estimated, and structural errors can affect the generative process and the resulting signal distribution. While recent work has established stability guarantees for graph neural ordinary differential equations, the robustness of graph-aware reference dynamics, as used in topological Schrödinger bridge models, remains largely unexplored. Here, we investigate the structural stability of continuous-time generative models whose dynamics combine a graph filter with a learned graph neural network. We first derive a Wasserstein stability bound that quantifies the effect of graph perturbations on the generated signal distributions. Informed by this analysis, we then propose a principled framework for designing graph filters that balance structural stability with induced signal smoothing. We characterize the optimal filter design and provide an explicit family of polynomial filters with provable stability guarantees. Experiments on synthetic graphs and real-world fMRI signals support our theoretical findings, illustrating the enhanced structural stability of the proposed filters while preserving generative performance.
item.title: Stabilizing Filters for Graph Signal Generation

item.summary: Satellite-based continuous-variable quantum key distribution (CV-QKD) is fundamentally constrained by finite communication windows, channel attenuation, and statistical fluctuations arising from a limited number of exchanged quantum states. This work develops a finite-size CV-QKD framework for satellite quantum communication under a hybrid noise model that jointly incorporates satellite geometry, atmospheric and propagation losses, quantum Poissonian noise coexisting with classical additive white Gaussian noise, detector imperfections, and composable finite-key security under collective attacks. A single canonical finite-size secret key rate (SKR) expression is derived in which the finite-size correction is stated in a strictly decreasing form in the block size, removing the ambiguity between the segmented and the block-level formulations used in earlier treatments. The finite-size accounting is further extended to the quantum bit error ratio (QBER) through an explicit parameter estimation penalty, so that the feasibility constraint inherits the same block-size dependence as the key rate. The framework quantifies the influence of reconciliation efficiency, transmission efficiency, detection efficiency, receiver aperture, beam waist, zenith angle, wavelength, and effective communication time. Numerical results reveal a significant performance gap between finite-size and asymptotic operation, indicating that asymptotic analysis can overestimate the feasible satellite altitude by a factor of several, and that the achievable range is governed by the number of signals actually exchanged rather than by any single physical channel parameter. These results establish block size as a first-class design variable for satellite CV-QKD mission dimensioning.
item.title: Finite-Size CV-QKD for Satellite Quantum Communication under a Hybrid Noise Model

item.summary: Electrical substation equipment is commonly interconnected by busbars and flexible conductors. Such interconnected infrastructures exhibit complex dynamic interactions, where the response of each component is influenced by local structural properties, mechanical coupling, system topology, and transient excitation. High-fidelity FE models can capture some of these effects, but their computational cost limits their use for real-time prediction. Purely data-driven models offer faster inference, yet they struggle to generalize, requiring additional simulations and retraining for each new configuration. This work presents a ROM embedded Graph Neural Network (ROMeGNN) for topology-aware seismic digital twins of interconnected structural systems. The system is represented as a graph, where structural components are treated as nodes and mechanical interconnections as edges. Each high-fidelity component model is first reduced to a reduced-order modal representation, which forms a differentiable dynamics operator within the GNN. Rather than learning the full response directly, the GNN estimates topology-dependent interaction forces that enter the differentiable ROM solver as coupling inputs for modal state advancement. This hybrid formulation preserves the known component-level physics and uses data-driven message passing to learn complex inter-component forces across varying system layouts. The framework is demonstrated on interconnected electrical substation equipment subjected to randomized seismic inputs. It delivers rapid predictions of response quantities relevant to seismic damage assessment while remaining applicable across varying layouts, component combinations, and excitation scenarios. These results highlight the potential of embedding physics within graph learning architectures for real-time, interpretable, topology-adaptive seismic digital twins of interconnected engineering systems.
item.title: Topology-Adaptive Seismic Response Prediction of Interconnected Structural Systems Using Reduced Order Model Embedded Graph Neural Network

item.summary: Low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites increasingly perform time-critical onboard processing, yet heterogeneous computing capabilities, rapidly changing inter-satellite links (ISLs) and uncertain neighbor behavior make decentralized task offloading difficult under partial observations. This paper presents ORCA, an architecture of Onboard Reflective Collaborative Agents for autonomous onboard task offloading. ORCA organizes offloading decisions into a four-Agent \emph{Perceive}$\rightarrow$\emph{Reason}$\rightarrow$ \emph{Act}$\rightarrow$\emph{Learn} loop. It aims to improve efficiency and reliability in dynamic, heterogeneous, and unreliable LEO satellite networks. The simulation results of a heterogeneous 60-satellite Walker-delta constellation demonstrates that ORCA delivers competitive system efficiency in cooperative settings while achieving superior task-success robustness and offloading reliability under previously unseen malicious node behavior, indicating that outcome-grounded reflection can improve the reliability of decentralized onboard offloading without centralized runtime coordination.
item.title: ORCA: Onboard Reflective Collaborative Agents for Reliable Task Offloading in LEO Satellite Networks

item.summary: Cross-subject EEG emotion recognition now reports accuracies above 90% on stimulus-defined benchmarks such as SEED, and the field has examined several ways in which such numbers can be inflated, attributing inflation to subject identity, to data partitioning, and to repeated stimulus presentation. We observe that one variable has been left out. On these datasets the emotion label is assigned to the video at design time, so any encoder that recovers which video was shown obtains the label for free. We adapt three representation-level shortcut diagnostics to a cohort of published contrastive cross-subject encoders, and find that stimulus identity is linearly recoverable at six to fifteen times chance. We then measure its impact on the reported accuracy by holding out subjects and stimuli jointly, and find that each released classifier loses two to forty-four points once the test videos are unseen, so a headline obtained under subject hold-out alone is not a measure of cross-subject emotion decoding.
item.title: How Much of Cross-Subject EEG Emotion Recognition Is Stimulus Memorization?

AI.conclusion: 分层星地协作架构与弹性部署策略可作为6G星地一体化网络的可行设计路径。
AI.method: 综述SGIN发展趋势并归纳两类典型应用场景；提出分层星地协作网络架构SGCN，并在三个代表性场景下与递进式基线进行对比评估；进一步设计业务感知的部署策略。

item.summary: The sixth-generation (6G) landscape demands a profound architectural evolution toward a unified, collaborative ecosystem that integrates satellite and terrestrial segments to provide ubiquitous global connectivity. Nevertheless, conventional independent management paradigms are increasingly challenged by the profound spatiotemporal nonstationarity of low-Earth orbit (LEO) channels and the volatile demands of massive heterogeneous services. To address these challenges, this study focuses on the architectural design of space-ground integrated networks (SGINs) and investigates elastic deployment strategies tailored to heterogeneous 6G service requirements. We first review the development trends in SGIN and then summarize typical application scenarios into two categories, along with their associated challenges and constraints. After that, a hierarchical space-ground collaborative network (SGCN) architecture is proposed to support achieving larger network capability, extensive continuous coverage, and enhanced spectral efficiency, which is evaluated through three representative scenarios with progressive baselines. Subsequently, a service-aware deployment strategy is introduced to further establish the engineering feasibility of the proposed architecture.
item.title: A Hierarchical Space-Ground Collaborative Network: Architecture Design and Deployment

AI.conclusion: 灵敏度收敛需更长仿真时间（1%误差需T≥6.6τ），短仿真会导致梯度与优化结果偏差，外推与更长截断可缓解。
AI.method: 对单模场衰减建立截断误差的解析估计（与Q、τ关系），在三个求解器中与仿真误差对照；分析弱耦合慢模腔、单极点与双极点滤波器优化；引入矩阵铅笔外推嵌入可微计算以缩短仿真时间。
AI.motivation: FDTD中基于DFT的S参数灵敏度（伴随/自动微分/有限差分）共享同一截断误差，方法间的一致性无法暴露该误差，且现有终止准则可能给出错误的优化梯度。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦FDTD电磁仿真中S参数灵敏度/伴随梯度的截断误差与优化，未涉及无线CSI获取、信道估计/反馈或无线AI方法。
AI.result: 解析估计在Q=1000-7000腔谐振处预测误差在4%以内；常见终止准则使S11幅度误差0.5 dB内但灵敏度误差10-72%；矩阵铅笔外推在短66倍的仿真中恢复灵敏度；双极点情形下1τ运行导致过耦合Δk≈1.24/Q。
AI.tldr: FDTD敏感性(梯度)因响应在有限仿真时间T截断而收敛慢于S参数，误差约为(1+T/τ)e^{-T/τ}；常见终止准则下梯度误差可达10-72%，矩阵铅笔外推可在短66倍的仿真中恢复正确梯度。

item.summary: In the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method, the sensitivities of S-parameters to design parameters come from discrete Fourier transforms of responses ending at a simulation time T. We show that, when a design parameter moves a resonance, the sensitivity converges later than the S-parameter. For a single mode with field decay time $\tau$, the truncation error of the sensitivity is $(1+T/\tau)e^{-T/\tau}$, against $e^{-T/\tau}$ for the resonant part of the S-parameter, so a 1% sensitivity error needs $T \geq 6.6\tau$ instead of $4.6\tau$. Automatic differentiation, the discrete adjoint and finite differences on the same run carry this error, so their agreement cannot reveal it. In three solvers, with no fitted parameter, the estimate predicts the simulated error within 4% at cavity resonances with $Q$ of 1000-7000; at lower $Q$ the error is larger. On a cavity whose slowest mode is weakly coupled, common end criteria leave $|S_{11}|$ within 0.5 dB of a 1.3 dB dip but its sensitivity 10-72% in error. A matrix-pencil extrapolation inside the differentiable computation recovers the sensitivity on a cavity with field probes from a run 66 times shorter. In a single-pole filter loop with a symmetric objective, truncation leaves the maximum of the objective in place, and the optimizer reaches the resonance of a full run despite the wrong gradient. With two coupled poles, the truncated objective moves the optimum: on runs of $1\tau$ it over-couples by $\Delta k \approx 1.24/Q$, and an equal-ripple objective still shifts it by about $0.2\bar{\alpha}$ at $3\tau$, but not at $4.6\tau$.
item.title: Delayed Convergence of S-Parameter Sensitivities to Design Parameters in FDTD Simulations

AI.conclusion: Airy波束的“绕障”轨迹特性并不带来接收功率增益，常规波束聚焦在多数实际情形下已是最优；遮挡场景下的预编码设计应聚焦于接收端几何与遮挡结构，而非Airy波形。
AI.method: 理论分析：在单天线接收端推导接收功率最优性，考虑任意数量天线被遮挡及CSI相位误差的期望情形；对多天线接收端引入相位可分离条件（秩一信道满足该条件）证明最优性；并用数值仿真对比物理小尺寸与大尺寸接收端下Airy波束与聚焦预编码。
AI.motivation: Airy波束被广泛提议用于阵列波束成形中绕过障碍物，但其相对常规波束聚焦的实际增益缺乏严格的理论比较，本文旨在检验Airy波束在遮挡场景下是否真能提升接收功率。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文涉及CSI相位误差下的波束聚焦最优性与预编码设计，属物理层波束成形理论，但既无CSI获取/反馈/压缩，也无AI方法，与核心方向仅弱相关。
AI.result: 对物理尺寸落在波束宽度内的接收端，未修改的波束聚焦在存在障碍时即为最优；对大尺寸接收端，最优预编码会偏向照射未被遮挡部分但仍不呈现Airy形态。Airy波束虽可调参获得较好性能，其在障碍前弯曲传播的轨迹并不能最大化障碍后的接收功率。
AI.tldr: 论文证明在单天线接收端（任意遮挡数、含CSI相位误差）以及秩一信道下的多天线接收端，常规波束聚焦（beamfocusing）均最大化接收功率，Airy波束并不能超越它；仅当接收端物理尺寸超过波束宽度时最优预编码才偏离聚焦，但也不会变成Airy波束。

item.summary: Airy beams are often proposed in array beamforming to bend beams around obstacles. We prove that, for a single-antenna receiver, conventional beamfocusing maximizes the received power regardless of how many antennas are blocked and, in expectation, even with phase errors in the channel state information. This also holds for multi-antenna receivers under a phase-separability condition that is satisfied in rank-one channels. Numerical results confirm that unmodified beamfocusing is optimal for physically small receivers (i.e., those that fit within the beamwidth) when an obstacle is present. For physically larger receivers, the optimal precoding deviates from beamfocusing to better illuminate the receiver's unobstructed parts, but will not become Airy beams. While Airy beams can be configured to perform well, their ability to follow a bent trajectory in front of an obstacle does not maximize the received power behind it.
item.title: Beamfocusing Versus Airy Beams: Does Antenna Blockage Require Beam Bending?

AI.conclusion: 碰撞式生日估计器是估计整数阶Rényi熵的最优实用方案，其集中性与极小极大最优性由尖锐的上下界分析共同确立。
AI.method: 对碰撞计数进行灵敏度分析以推导Bernstein型集中界；下界则基于对"平台分布中隐藏尖峰"检测问题的精细分析，且无需样本分割、截断或中位数聚合。
AI.motivation: 碰撞是探测未知分布的基本手段，并构成Rényi熵这一基础不确定性度量的核心，因此需要厘清基于碰撞计数的自然估计器（生日估计器）的最优性与样本复杂度。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文属于理论统计/信息论范畴的熵估计研究，未涉及无线通信、CSI获取、信道估计或反馈等主题。
AI.result: 生日估计器被证明为极小极大最优，且在所有参数区域上联合一致；闭合了整数阶Rényi熵估计已知上下界之间的差距，样本复杂度在绝对常数意义下被确定。
AI.tldr: 该文研究基于碰撞计数的"生日估计器"，证明其Bernstein型集中不等式且在字母表大小、阶数、精度与置信度上联合一致地极小极大最优，从而解决了整数阶Rényi熵估计的样本复杂度问题。

item.summary: Collisions are a basic probe of unknown distributions, used for testing and for counting substructures in graphs, and they underlie Rényi entropy, a fundamental measure of uncertainty with applications in cryptography, machine learning, physics, and biology. Motivated by this, we study the natural birthday estimator. We prove Bernstein-type concentration for it and show that it is minimax optimal, uniformly and jointly in alphabet size, order, accuracy, and confidence, with no sample splitting, clipping, or median aggregation. This, in particular, settles the sample complexity of integer-order Rényi entropy estimation up to absolute constants in all regimes, closing the gap between the best known upper and lower bounds. Our concentration bound rests on a sensitivity analysis of collision count, and the matching lower bound on a sharp analysis of detecting a hidden spike in a plateau distribution.
item.title: Birthday Estimators Are Uniformly Optimal for Renyi Entropy

AI.conclusion: 该工作给出量子交换机图态分发的最小持久内存理论刻画与最优、高效的在线协议，并可推广到最小量子发射器的顺序图态生成。
AI.method: 通过稳定子形式化刻画任意用户Bell链路生成与处理子集后的最小持久交换机内存，并设计在线稳定子转换协议，在量子比特数n上多项式时间实现该极限；同一框架还给出顺序图态生成所需最少量子发射器的正向构造。
AI.motivation: Bell对生成具有概率性，不同链路成功时间不同，需暂存量子比特；现有Piecemaker等协议未刻画各阶段最小持久内存，且局部覆盖方法计算代价高，因此需要最优且高效的协议。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文主题为量子网络中的图态分发与量子交换机内存优化，与无线通信CSI获取、信道估计或CSI反馈压缩无任何关联。
